Wisconsin is a key battleground as we fight to defend voting rights. Time after time opponents of voting rights have tried to guarantee their control over our state at the expense of our democracy -- and there's no telling what those vote suppressors might try next.
It's all about the upcoming elections, Team, and we MUST protect our democracy in Wisconsin and beyond. RUSH $25 or more right now so we can keep fighting for fair maps, fair representation, ballot access, and more >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100324_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=100324_3&amount=25]
Wisconsin Public Radio: Republican bill would abolish Wisconsin Elections Commission [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100324_3&amount=25]
Team: First, Opponents of voting rights gerrymandered Wisconsin. Then they lost critical elections for Governor and State Supreme Court. Then they tried to fire the nonpartisan Wisconsin Elections Commission Administrator. Now they want to abolish the commission and give it's power to themselves to run their partisan agenda.
The Elections Administrator -- who " has been the subject of conspiracy theories and threats from election skeptics who falsely claim she was part of a plan to rig the 2020 vote in Wisconsin " -- has refused to give in to lies about how elections are run in Wisconsin. So the vote suppressors in the Wisconsin legislature just introduced a bill that would abolish the Wisconsin Elections Commission entirely and grant more power over elections to the state's Republican-controlled Legislature.
These state legislators are clearly obsessed with protecting their own power and will seemingly stop at nothing to stay in control of the most gerrymandered state in the country. This bill raises huge concerns about how this critical state -- where the margin of victory in the last presidential election came down to less than a percentage point -- will conduct the 2024 election.

The Cook Political Report’s survey showed an 11-point swing among independent voters toward our campaign, making this a TIED race with less than 34 days left until Election Day. But there’s a MASSIVE catch. Chuck Schumer and Kamala Harris are racing millions into Wisconsin to stop the bleeding and stabilize Tammy’s polling numbers. We have 24 hours to raise $75,000 from grassroots supporters to maintain our momentum and overtake Tammy Baldwin in the polls. Allowing Tammy Baldwin to stabilize her polling numbers at this late stage in the race would be catastrophic. It would give Democrats a major victory in a state that will decide the Senate Majority and the Presidency. Too much is on the line to ignore this request. body:
| Friend,

You may have heard about Mitch McConnell's $22.5 million investment to defeat us in Michigan, but I wanted to weigh in personally about what this means for our race.

First and foremost, I've heard from a number of people that maybe they think we're going to win this race because this is Michigan and Democrats win in Michigan.

Um, no.

Michigan is a swing state, full stop. And just because it's swung to Democrats in the last election or two, it can swing right back. It was not too long ago that Trump won here once before – by just 10,704 votes.

And if you need further evidence of that - look at the McConnell super PAC buy to beat us.

Mitch McConnell is many things, but he is no fool. He is not going to take $22.5 million and light it on fire. He could spend that in a lot of other places, but he chose to spend it to defeat me.

And that's because they think they can win here.

He's right.

They can win here.

Mike Rogers could win and carry Donald Trump over the finish line here as well.

But that will not happen if we have the resources to respond to this McConnell ad buy.

That's why I am turning to you. Because emails like this are a single greatest source of fundraising for our campaign at this point.

* While 80% of Americans support legal abortion, MAGA Republicans have been leading abortion ban legislation at the state and national levels.
* While most Americans support equal rights and protections for the LGBTQ+ community, the MAGA agenda actively promotes anti-LGBTQ+ rhetoric and policies.
* And while most Americans broadly agree we should pass more gun safety legislation — 90% of voters support universal background checks — Republicans in power continue to block life-saving, common sense laws.

subject: 🚨Turning Anxiety into Action! - Time to be BOLD for America🇺🇸
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY]( "PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY")
body:
It is now or never to save the country. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a2f6b554fdb3/n41kepo7ku-12714317?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=0e5cb8bbaa&e=25844e23a8)
---
| | Peter,
---
|
---
|
---
> **From the Desk of Todd Watson; NEGOP Political Director,** **A lot of people are anxious about the state of the country. Inflation woes, property taxes, education of children, immigration, constitutional rights, OR greater political concerns from perception of the opposition seemingly having the upper hand or canvassing advantage, Harris-Biden-Walz on t.v., etc. We understand these are worrying times and this creates nervousness in people.** **Candidates are receiving calls that they should be doing “This”. The state and local parties are receiving calls that they should be doing “That”. County chairs are being pulled in all directions...why are you not doing “This AND That”?** **Here are some basic things you can do to ease the feelings of anxiousness and see, be, and create real political progress. **
> 1. **_Turn off main stream media. _ The media is not on Constitutional America’s side. They peddle fear, create doubt, publish erroneous and purposefully “pendulum” polls to sway opinions, work against common sense values, etc. As much as conservative America knows the media is not for them...they still consume way too much false and deceiving information and give control of their emotions to agenda driven media outlets. ‘Are you consuming info or working’ is a question one must ask themself. **
> 2. **_Focus on what you can control._ We understand, just as much as most Americans, EVERYTHING that is wrong and crazy in this political world. No one voted for Kamala Harris and yet she is eligible for President. Yelling at the situation isn’t changing anything. Yelling at the latest Department of Education mandate isn’t changing anything. Put your energy into your local Constitutional and Platform Republican candidates to overcome the LOCAL lunacy. **
> 3. **_Connect to voters_ to turn in ballots and/or travel to the polls. Unfortunately, it is clear that the Democrats have worked very hard to “Generate Ballots” using the vote-by-mail apparatus. The percentages in Nebraska are astronomical again this cycle, despite the fact one should have their ID verified directly before the ballot is cast. Have you obtained the list of those who have requested voting early? Have you made a concerted effort to reach out to these voters and have a conversation on how they are voting and why? Engaging those with these ballots SOLVES a problem! It can earn a vote for our candidates and that's the MOST important activity you can do in the next 30 days. NOTHING is more important than getting out the VOTE!**
> 4. **_Change your mindset._ We receive a lot of nervous questions on how the party is working to “Get Out the Vote”. The state and local parties are staffed by...YOU. So, let us be the first to turn the question on its head.**
>
**What is your plan for “Getting out the Vote”? ** **Did you know evangelicals have some of the poorest voting records? What are you doing to make sure evangelicals at your local church are voting in 2024 instead of staying at home? Do they know precious life is on the line? Do they know religious freedom is on the line? Did you know gun owners are some of the worst voting blocks in the country and have the most to lose this election? What are you doing at your local gun clubs to make sure they vote? Bottomline: American voters have to change their behavior/mindset and take responsibility for turning out the vote.** **The #1 Thing you can do is organize 20-100 people to make sure they are turning in their ballot and/or traveling to the voting booth.**
> 5. **_Understand the IMPORTANCE._ It is tedious, time consuming, micro-managing, and 100% the BEST thing you can do TODAY to ensure a Constitutional America TOMORROW. The rank and file Republican voters often forget to vote. You need to hand hold in 2024 to ensure they do vote. Do not look for someone else to do the job you have the ability to do. Take responsibility for 100 people and do the micromanaging to make sure they vote Republican. Ask your local churches to have a policy discussion group meeting, or visit your gun clubs and talk with members, visit EVERYWHERE. Don’t let babies die and Constitutional America perish on your watch. Make sure you do your part. Doing hard work will aleve some anxiety and free your conscience knowing you did what you could do to save the country. **
>
**Anxiety happens when we fear what is happening due to things we can’t control. Direct that nervous energy into positive behavior into what you CAN control. When you visit with your neighbor you will quickly learn that most people are reasonable and think similar to you. The important thing is making sure common sense America votes so we don’t have 4 more years of America going backwards and losing thousands of lives in Nebraska. ** **The Primary Election numbers spoke to apathy. Apathy cannot happen in 2024 with literal lives and Constitutional America on the line. Turn that anxious energy into positive proactive work to win!** **Thanks to all of you already doing WORK to WIN. ** **Todd Watson
> Political Director
> NEGOP**

clean_body: It is now or never to save the country. | | | | | | | Peter, | | From the Desk of Todd Watson; NEGOP Political Director, A lot of people are anxious about the state of the country. Inflation woes, property taxes, education of children, immigration, constitutional rights, OR greater political concerns from perception of the opposition seemingly having the upper hand or canvassing advantage, Harris-Biden-Walz on t.v., etc. We understand these are worrying times and this creates nervousness in people. Candidates are receiving calls that they should be doing “This”. The state and local parties are receiving calls that they should be doing “That”. County chairs are being pulled in all directions...why are you not doing “This AND That”? Here are some basic things you can do to ease the feelings of anxiousness and see, be, and create real political progress. 1. Turn off main stream media. The media is not on Constitutional America’s side. They peddle fear, create doubt, publish erroneous and purposefully “pendulum” polls to sway opinions, work against common sense values, etc. As much as conservative America knows the media is not for them...they still consume way too much false and deceiving information and give control of their emotions to agenda driven media outlets. ‘Are you consuming info or working’ is a question one must ask themself. 2. Focus on what you can control. We understand, just as much as most Americans, EVERYTHING that is wrong and crazy in this political world. No one voted for Kamala Harris and yet she is eligible for President. Yelling at the situation isn’t changing anything. Yelling at the latest Department of Education mandate isn’t changing anything. Put your energy into your local Constitutional and Platform Republican candidates to overcome the LOCAL lunacy. 3. Connect to voters to turn in ballots and/or travel to the polls. Unfortunately, it is clear that the Democrats have worked very hard to “Generate Ballots” using the vote-by-mail apparatus. The percentages in Nebraska are astronomical again this cycle, despite the fact one should have their ID verified directly before the ballot is cast. Have you obtained the list of those who have requested voting early? Have you made a concerted effort to reach out to these voters and have a conversation on how they are voting and why? Engaging those with these ballots SOLVES a problem! It can earn a vote for our candidates and that's the MOST important activity you can do in the next 30 days. NOTHING is more important than getting out the VOTE! 4. Change your mindset. We receive a lot of nervous questions on how the party is working to “Get Out the Vote”. The state and local parties are staffed by...YOU. So, let us be the first to turn the question on its head. What is your plan for “Getting out the Vote”? Did you know evangelicals have some of the poorest voting records? What are you doing to make sure evangelicals at your local church are voting in 2024 instead of staying at home? Do they know precious life is on the line? Do they know religious freedom is on the line? Did you know gun owners are some of the worst voting blocks in the country and have the most to lose this election? What are you doing at your local gun clubs to make sure they vote? Bottomline: American voters have to change their behavior/mindset and take responsibility for turning out the vote. The #1 Thing you can do is organize 20-100 people to make sure they are turning in their ballot and/or traveling to the voting booth. 5. Understand the IMPORTANCE. It is tedious, time consuming, micro-managing, and 100% the BEST thing you can do TODAY to ensure a Constitutional America TOMORROW. The rank and file Republican voters often forget to vote. You need to hand hold in 2024 to ensure they do vote. Do not look for someone else to do the job you have the ability to do. Take responsibility for 100 people and do the micromanaging to make sure they vote Republican. Ask your local churches to have a policy discussion group meeting, or visit your gun clubs and talk with members, visit EVERYWHERE. Don’t let babies die and Constitutional America perish on your watch. Make sure you do your part. Doing hard work will aleve some anxiety and free your conscience knowing you did what you could do to save the country. Anxiety happens when we fear what is happening due to things we can’t control. Direct that nervous energy into positive behavior into what you CAN control. When you visit with your neighbor you will quickly learn that most people are reasonable and think similar to you. The important thing is making sure common sense America votes so we don’t have 4 more years of America going backwards and losing thousands of lives in Nebraska. The Primary Election numbers spoke to apathy. Apathy cannot happen in 2024 with literal lives and Constitutional America on the line. Turn that anxious energy into positive proactive work to win! Thanks to all of you already doing WORK to WIN. Todd Watson Political Director NEGOP | | Click on the Video for a great resource into grassroots engagement. clean_body: Two breaking polls released today show that our campaign to defeat Tammy Baldwin and flip Wisconsin’s CRUCIAL Senate seat has all the momentum heading into the race's final month. | Peter, Two breaking polls released today show that our campaign to defeat Tammy Baldwin and flip Wisconsin’s CRUCIAL Senate seat has all the momentum heading into the race's final month. The Cook Political Report’s survey showed an 11-point swing among independent voters toward our campaign, making this a TIED race with less than 34 days left until Election Day. But there’s a MASSIVE catch. Chuck Schumer and Kamala Harris are racing millions into Wisconsin to stop the bleeding and stabilize Tammy’s polling numbers. We have 24 hours to raise $75,000 from grassroots supporters to maintain our momentum and overtake Tammy Baldwin in the polls. Allowing Tammy Baldwin to stabilize her polling numbers at this late stage in the race would be catastrophic. It would give Democrats a major victory in a state that will decide the Senate Majority and the Presidency. Too much is on the line to ignore this request. Thank you, Eric Hovde Republican for U.S. Senate | MEET ERIC Eric's a fourth-generation Wisconsinite, born and raised in the Madison area. He's a serial entrepreneur. He founded and managed his first business in his twenties and then went on to start and build many others. When he is not running his businesses, he is focused on his family and his philanthropic endeavors. He and his brother Steve operate 10 Hovde Homes around the world that provide shelter, supportive services and love to vulnerable children. Join the Conversation: | Paid for by Hovde for Wisconsin

In contrast, I was proud to lay out my plan to protect voting rights, workers’ rights, women’s rights, and take on corporate greed.
We’re ready to make this case to voters in every corner of the Commonwealth, but, as Lucas Kunce and I know, we need the resources to do so. With just 33 days until Election Day, we’re running out of time.

Right now, the polls show me tied with David McCormick, and experts are predicting this race is a toss up. With Pennsylvania deciding the fate of the Senate and White House this November, the stakes are higher than ever before.

# Over 662,000 Non-Citizen Criminals Have Been Released Into Our Country
---
| On March 13, 2024, [**Congressman Tony Gonzales (TX-23) penned a letter to President Biden and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas**](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=dd4ebff13d&e=638e6c2751 "https://gonzales.house.gov/_cache/files/a/1/a13552b6-8f1f-4c1d-b99b-aeb05db2fc83/ED414D83ECE83781868CDDD49224E051.3.13.24-sanctuary-city-letter-final.pdf") expressing his concern over policies in sanctuary cities that shield non-citizens from federal law enforcement and requested information on illegal immigrants on ICE’s docket to better understand how many potential criminals were being released into our communities.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | On September 27, 2004, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) Deputy Director Patrick Lechleiter responded to Congressman Gonzales’ inquiry with data that confirms as of July 2024, 662,566 illegal immigrants on ICE’s docket have a criminal history.
---
|
---
| These criminal illegal immigrants include 15,000 murderers loose in the US not to mention 1,000 arsonists, 20,000 rapists, 7,000 peeping toms, 17,000 burglars, etc. [**You can read the entire report from ICE when you click here.**](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=a00f85732f&e=638e6c2751)
As a former county supervisor, I emphasize to you that the federal policies that have left the border open are compounded by local government mandates that tie the hands of law enforcement. Jurisdictions refuse to honor ICE detainer requests and local sanctuary policies protect dangerous criminals.
**Did Our Current Congresswoman Comment on This Report?** Although my opponent sits on the House Judiciary Committee and the Sub Committee on Immigration and Citizenship, there is not a word from her on this report. Check her website.
As a member of the J6 Select Committee, our Congresswoman appears to believe that a grandma, who drove from Colorado to pray at the Capitol on January 6th is far more dangerous than 15,000 murders loose in our country.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | “Praying Grandma” Rebecca Lavrenz, 72 (in yellow circle), was fined $103,000 and confined to home for 6 months because she followed the crowd into the Capitol for 10 minutes.
---
|
---
| **We Need to Take Back Our Country!** Upon taking my seat in Congress, my number one priority is fixing immigration. First, we need to CLOSE the border and then simplify the immigration process and strengthen the value of citizenship.
Ballots start dropping October 7th. Will you help me get the word out? A quarter page ad in local papers is $500. Thank you for your support.

### President Trump Returns to the Historic City of
### Butler, Pennsylvania Three Months After Surviving His First Assassination Attempt
|
---
President Donald J. Trump will return to Butler, Pennsylvania on **Saturday, Oct. 5th** to hold a historic rally on the very ground where he came within inches of losing his life just three months ago.
This marks President Trump’s first visit to the site since the tragic attack on July 13th, when an assassin’s bullet nearly took him from us—an outcome only averted by what many have called divine providence. Now, President Trump is returning to honor the American heroes who stood by him that day and to continue his mission to save our great nation.

During this special rally, President Trump will pay **tribute to Corey Comperatore** , the selfless hero who gave his life to protect his wife and daughters during the attack. He will also **recognize the bravery of David Dutch and James Copenhaver** , who were wounded that day, and express deep gratitude to the law enforcement officers, first responders, and the Butler community for their overwhelming support.
This rally in Butler will be a testament to the unbreakable American spirit. As President Trump has often said, we do not let evil have the last word. When terrorists tried to bring down our skyscrapers, we rebuilt. When disaster strikes, we come back stronger. And when an assassin sought to end this movement, President Trump emerged more determined than ever. This rally will be a powerful celebration of resilience, unity, and our shared vision for the future of America.
Despite **two attempts on his life in just the past 9 weeks** , President Trump’s resolve has only grown stronger. He took a bullet for democracy on that fateful day in July, and on November 5th, with the help of the amazing people of Pennsylvania, he will finish the job and save our democracy.
Join us in Butler as we rally together to make America safer, stronger, freer, and greater than ever before. This is an event the world will never forget!
Stay tuned for more information and details on how to register and support Trump 47 Committee. We look forward to seeing you there!
Thank you for your unwavering support. Together, we will make history.

Trump will return to Butler, Pennsylvania on Saturday, Oct. 5th to hold a historic rally on the very ground where he came within inches of losing his life just three months ago. This marks President Trump’s first visit to the site since the tragic attack on July 13th, when an assassin’s bullet nearly took him from us—an outcome only averted by what many have called divine providence. Now, President Trump is returning to honor the American heroes who stood by him that day and to continue his mission to save our great nation. | | During this special rally, President Trump will pay tribute to Corey Comperatore , the selfless hero who gave his life to protect his wife and daughters during the attack. This rally in Butler will be a testament to the unbreakable American spirit. As President Trump has often said, we do not let evil have the last word. When terrorists tried to bring down our skyscrapers, we rebuilt. When disaster strikes, we come back stronger. And when an assassin sought to end this movement, President Trump emerged more determined than ever. This rally will be a powerful celebration of resilience, unity, and our shared vision for the future of America. Despite two attempts on his life in just the past 9 weeks , President Trump’s resolve has only grown stronger. He took a bullet for democracy on that fateful day in July, and on November 5th, with the help of the amazing people of Pennsylvania, he will finish the job and save our democracy. Join us in Butler as we rally together to make America safer, stronger, freer, and greater than ever before. This is an event the world will never forget! It's no wonder **[hear.com's](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=378193a0e5134ba4b44d3f31ae55c104&_e=1Chw_NYl0_dKhkq_ZpjfdFCQ56wMiyIMmnJDDHbMFZ8TzOi9hThB2rt4tFj2WgTyW07ni8VoNG71vDXaiB3qRQTvxbvsRPPzTGBjyNU28C6EH7j_j8HnINsq00kwwFWpsO4JxtJYvHp7nU8KlxnYEUREQ_mlNM4qC4LzzwQ-S2AlhBLB3ky0K1krWGVBey5Dj-Y6Ozt78ZnX74rnXrh1sFz7GNk3oIKoIiX2RUobNvjrK5oTLZZJ8ngPMJylFaMdqmSAfiq-xEklvgqTn0A2bPKX58iYO1n0lSBF4CSKecjm_sKnxonFOwA973R8GdvVwl6eSAPtBs5i84KZjKcTMvUS73t1IQqKOZyZkOJIREWcdPv5024Ei9Xd9feDFlyxXXSnB2VfA4rEcg7T_V5N3LaovYsXjcDLS8dBm1peh_OaZ8404khMSgOhVU8i7LRjam5WfTOUDtmLd0hHHflcyr9UDI3FSQsEOpQaqXul2YA%3D) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

It's one of **the world 's first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it's the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=378193a0e5134ba4b44d3f31ae55c104&_e=1Chw_NYl0_dKhkq_ZpjfdFCQ56wMiyIMmnJDDHbMFZ8TzOi9hThB2rt4tFj2WgTyW07ni8VoNG71vDXaiB3qRQTvxbvsRPPzTGBjyNU28C6EH7j_j8HnINsq00kwwFWpsO4JxtJYvHp7nU8KlxnYEUREQ_mlNM4qC4LzzwQ-S2AlhBLB3ky0K1krWGVBey5Dj-Y6Ozt78ZnX74rnXrh1sFz7GNk3oIKoIiX2RUobNvjrK5oTLZZJ8ngPMJylFaMdqmSAfiq-xEklvgqTn0A2bPKX58iYO1n0lSBF4CSKecjm_sKnxonFOwA973R8GdvVwl6eSAPtBs5i84KZjKcTMjqH6OjY7akP5Fkx4G6lQuqQ_aDvhRkoKi5n2_yEwRswT7F4nQO2DnHvejkWDGmZuxVzvMpuC0Sfhg6AiQSNza7Fp9t4cxArooyuFLH8B129VWQuPQY1M-t-KI-ZwxhOe54X2QBqQBBbPWa9UAi7kmg%3D) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids--from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming--with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

"It's not just about volume," explains [hear.com's](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=378193a0e5134ba4b44d3f31ae55c104&_e=1Chw_NYl0_dKhkq_ZpjfdFCQ56wMiyIMmnJDDHbMFZ8TzOi9hThB2rt4tFj2WgTyW07ni8VoNG71vDXaiB3qRQTvxbvsRPPzTGBjyNU28C6EH7j_j8HnINsq00kwwFWpsO4JxtJYvHp7nU8KlxnYEUREQ_mlNM4qC4LzzwQ-S2AlhBLB3ky0K1krWGVBey5Dj-Y6Ozt78ZnX74rnXrh1sFz7GNk3oIKoIiX2RUobNvjrK5oTLZZJ8ngPMJylFaMdqmSAfiq-xEklvgqTn0A2bPKX58iYO1n0lSBF4CSKecjm_sKnxonFOwA973R8GdvVwl6eSAPtBs5i84KZjKcTMm56cewgOq-tMX4F4eWq1cWDk3eUlmD74M2cKgMiIMEApWXHvuZSOqJcSx5C4_LevklSqqa3rGnshsDJEJDgpm4jrmYliFk8Jy_TjCC0USaTk3oXG1yvC6JxVz_XMcG_RhhO29qb4ONyFpwF1ttciI0%3D) founder Paul Crusius. "It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize."

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity --and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

## Dockworkers' Strike Suspended until January
The union representing 45,000 U.S. dockworkers has agreed [to suspend their strike](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb7a444LxwFCp8pYuVdXRInBOaIiJgCTK31fp3OFNb3jS-94vexdT3I4f7sK2rXlxvsU7LyB76pEW6oJdmZFVxxZGNHIHgNCdrFHa8DRKQBeAJq2ZJ-lGj57MtDrZRYsSCaR8YWA3eIcalDz4UZNRfBAkOcSWy_CT49ZOvKZnvnMZfL50yZ5au1ah3gTOAmd38Bs_6nDMLy1w_voUOIfsz49czlxqX1uJZ-7rrV55Cxz6mm_FcxU415bLU6g5BqHeAYhop4zuig3XR0wpVj0KkseLi-kv3v5fcbf4GwAA___l6V-v) until Jan. 15 to allow time to finalize contract negotiations, according to sources.The strike, [which began early Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD9vwyAUxD8N3l4ED_wnA0MXb-na0cLmEdNgsIAk8rev3K4d7nTSST-d7us23YwPPt4_zUa6ujSZpfoXTYKDAlSTaqx2REiyIS16HHgrBIpm1a20wonZzW137Vp7deraS4mi7wZ0A7nGa-SoBOenBtFeFoOdkHxe-k4NkmamOFlfU758Jx_rSi4c6UX5sqStCXqtdS9MfjAcGY7x2FOpZ8VwPMEMR8EZjlwyHJ8FIr3LX9pTrvBO-UG5gIkW0k7Z1JQLZDLLCpZMgJqAogUypcKSTi81-weB3zay3lQKBzyjTxGKOU50k7Xd3z4EX7qeKX7fjA-_Y-v_1700_gQAAP__VGRxKQ), shut down ports from Maine to Texas for the first time since 1977. A new preliminary agreement includes an approximate 62% wage increase for union members, with work resuming at all affected ports. The union initially sought a 77% pay raise over six years, with current base salaries around $81,000 annually.In contrast, Harold Daggett, president of the ILA, who had vowed to "cripple" the U.S. economy over automation and wage demands, earns $728,000 annually as OILA chief and lives in a 7,136-square-foot mansion on a 10-acre estate in Sparta, New Jersey, with a Bentley and a pool. [See photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD3P4yAQhH8N7jaCNf5IQXENXa690lrjtU2EwQKSKP_-5Ld-i6lGGs3z_HtMD_LBx-0vHWzqmiZy1b95UhI0oJ50s5iVGblt2KgBR9kpharZDS7rfdayG3h2A-pxbeneugFb13Wy19h4gxK1kvLKqLqbI-xVK2c39HpseRZa8uJryrdn8rHuvIZvenO-uXQ0wey1nkW0fwRagTZ-z1TqVQm017BAq6RAK1GgnV_FRy5FoN0pp7DAQtvGtRYoZ6bPhQjxCQfF4lOEnQrMHGvgL3TgKMNGmTYGigtsLy4V9vQqLNA22Sznx4fgSz8ILbeDfPi5WH8X9jb4PwAA___B6Gzr).
## FBI, Microsoft Seize Russian Spy Sites
The FBI and Microsoft have seized [over 100 web domains](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyhCAQQL8GOxxYUWko0thd2pQO4HpuBuWGxXMuX5-51Cle9Zo37-s23zwlOu6ffkdX1zz7WOmJs1bSSDCzaRa3IgJ2DTo9glW91qCbzSkfEKzvETVgb4IyY1iDsUPExXb90JADBUYr9cbqvo0eBt2pEMfB2A6DMAoXqrm035mOuuGaXvmJpY15b5Lban2w6D4ETAKm67raI8QDL357AVPFuAmYGONZqL4ETCfLnWLJnNcqGekHpVZKXhiYKrL0KeEdl_SSJ-Miy8lM_pD8IGRZ4uH12I3WNMUtj4tSIh5GYdR995T-our_i54OfgMAAP__vrNqlQ) allegedly used by Russian intelligence for cyber-espionage operations that targeted U.S. agencies, Russian nonprofits, and Kremlin-critical media outlets.According to court [documents unsealed Thursday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8Gb1jwwDgZGLp4S9eOFoZHeBWEyJBY6ddX6dzhphtO93VZL44y3a6frqDtsa7Od3riKgXXHPSqh2AjIqAa0MoZTmKSEuSQ7DkqJzfw86xMBAhxAmW2zcNZRBEiDmRBgJZCvDnJafQOjFRi87PRJ4Ub0wID9bqP35VuPWHMr_rEffS1DNmm3u-NqQ8GC4PlOI7x5VKtb8tg6egTg6WQ32ursfNH4w3pB3moxdGt8UfDwEGos5LKTGPqJQ-7DfeDcqZmZqbFtTjKf7n-__zTwm8AAAD__1BYW-Q), the seized websites were used in a "spear phishing campaign" to trick victims into revealing sensitive information, aiming to steal valuable data and U.S. government intelligence.Officials say Russian operatives, [active since 2017](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FurDAQRb_G7ow8Yy-whYvX0O1rUyJjD8tEBq-wF5R8fUTqFFe60imOzsdjfHhOvD3_-5VcnfPoQ-WDRtDKKrSjldHNREhGkoMOe30DQJCLM30gbAn0PXpLdAM738MUQwfgTResZIcaLWh9rYdbEzy2YPQUutb2hiZhNUWueW8-M291oTl95YP2JuRVJrfU-irC_BM4CBzO82zCVDY6y8UFDtcVOLyLWjnsueS5qv1dCnsV8-p5K6oQf1MUOMjdxdfJKXFpO2H1c_Wcfj317-rD4U8AAAD__ykqWtk), targeted nonprofits, think tanks, and officials supporting Ukraine and NATO, including former U.S. intelligence employees, Defense Department personnel, State and Energy employees, and military contractors.The Justice Department seized 41 internet domains, while Microsoft seized an additional 66 domains operated by Russian agents.
## Costco Now Offering Platinum Bars
Costco is expanding its precious metals offerings by adding Swiss-made [1-ounce platinum bars](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uhDAQhJ_GdEb2shykcJGG7tKmRP5Z321kMDI-0L19ROoUI400I33S932f75YTr48vu5CpMc_WVz5o1kqiBJyxCSYSAXUNGT3AqHqtQTdP0wUP2I_onMYQP3AIGHQfoyLtI8DQsAEFqJW6Muq-9RZuulPODzccO3ICFQWuubQ_mdf6pJje-aDS-rw0yTxr3XbRfQqYBEznebbe7Sud-7ULmK4qYPJ5rz7LLdnK62uRzha5FfYkNyoyv1ZP8vpIe1hO1nHi-paPnIKAqSkmbCenxPttEKgei-X0x6__2zgM_AYAAP__LVBjlA). This builds on last year's popular rollout of gold bars, which often sold out within hours.Priced at [$1,089.99 per bar](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEbjwYt5hYvX0G3alMjYwzKRwQjPLsrfR5s6xa2udHR0Pu_TPXDm_fERNvKylClE4RdNBrTVaCfbJL8QIXUNeeNwgJsxaJrV2y7N_6CD5JYhUp96hBvi4JKjoe_d3LBHQGsA3hvMrY0Be9PBHF1vh45mZYESSznbr8K7rLTk7_Kis41la7JfRY6quv8KR4XjdV1t3Of4PhWOb7TC0YDCEVDhGEuVWHRIqeojB-H9uek5nFVL0SxVHydFLs-qN5KQq8680_NoV9lyc_p0XJwz194pC48tcP61kL-bvDz-BAAA___VXmL1), the platinum is available exclusively to Costco members through its website. Bars cannot be delivered to Louisiana, Nevada, or Puerto Rico.Costco's precious metal business has been [highly profitable, ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD-v4yAQxD8N7ohgwX9SUJwU0eXaKy2M18ne8ccCnCjf_uT32ldssyPNb2b-3Oe7o0Dp8dtFNG3Ls_ONXjhLwTUHPetuNRsioOrQyBEm0UsJsnuaRSBMwwrqiqPr5VV50Q_KObjqScul78iAAC2FOG-S_cU7GKQSix8HPSlcmBa4Usvl8jdTak_cwie_sFx8jl0wz9b2ytQvBpaBTZ8913ZKDOxpzMBKwcAKYGCXo1LCWhlYn2vzmVPlFcNZje_BNUpH5IsrlftMqfItFy7_8Zz4G5dKDU-KskeLs3dxd_RITN2-oQyG8x9xpSMydSu4YSkudMWs-5tCoDqMTItHdBS-wrefp3wZ-B8AAP__G2B2AQ)with the retailer selling as much as $200 million a month in gold bars.The value of platinum has increased more than 15% over the past 12 months, closing at $1,019.60 an ounce Wednesday.

I'm at my wits' end, Friend.

The Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising chest. Now, they've just dumped $5.5 million into Montana, and are set on defeating me.

At this point, if I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I lose my House seat, Republicans may never hold the majority in Congress again.
**Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump 's Secretary of the Interior and I was a ground forces commander at SEAL Team 6.**
**I 'm also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation.**
But if the Democrats can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance.

**Good morning!** On this day in 1876, [Thomas S. Gathright](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFurDAQANDTmA40Hnsxv3DxG7pNmxLN2rPYisErPILN7SOlzwme3ud9uVMueV8_aGMv72ddKEg-edHQ2x7tYrvoHxD_6Y69djiBtTiZLnlDgWxAQO20QzAQp5sZJ74xxOfoQpc9AloNYDXcRmMGqzGMk4uONDoXgrLAMUs9Bkks_Kb2LN_15GMIdeuKTyKvpsx_hbPC-bquQVqiupe881CPVeGcaI-PWr8UzrzLkbkpnFeSdOQ1SS-pbtT61h0-vq5cSm6jUxbWjXL5VeSP9OnxJwAA__9xY1ox) was appointed the first president of the Agricultural and Mechanical College of Texas, which would later become Texas A&M University. If you need a dentist, TikTok might not be the best place to look for recommendations. Read about the experience of an unfortunate Texas woman [who did just that](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtygzAQAL9GdPLocUa4UJGGzmlTMkI6wyUCMej8_PqM06feZne_zsM5UKZ1-gwLen5cyhAi0w0HrSRIAwM0yY8qnXSDXjvTKQDT2Wb2oFsEZ_GkNDh9Ui516MLoTOjsqDrXkDfKgFYKtDq21h5Am9h2LrmgjXMxClCYiMt-4BkZH6Fe8rPccD_EsjTZz8xbFfZDmF6YPoxR2zcRpt9KZWH672tYkTnIWnJZyipDjNeKSW77uyLSOsmEK1Pl_SkzRVwrSqoLZXzJWOqCTFEmrDStL_kT-Cl3jGVPVda53IXp9dG20AII0ze7T9udcqbaOgFqWgLlP1X-59zNm98AAAD__yMcchU) in today's edition! Today's sponsor is [Rosetta Stone](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7tuwzAMAL9G3mKQNPUaNHTxlq4dDUaSEwFKFNiCm_59ke7dbjgccF_n5Syllsf1U-459NfaFom9HHlBOPGJeOEhhQskj0MOaMkBM7lpuAWvwSGjNRJtFGaRi0aXTCLR5NANJRAQIwAjaDNNIyNF42yygmRtjIohp9LbNvZb7vkl-1p_2pG3Mbb7UMOt9-eupg9Fs6JZ1nXc2p57l723R35LiuaoaGavAb1TNKMHA6Df5Lz1wxbS87vUWnZjFcP1LqX-1fs_s0eg3wAAAP__XQJSfg), the experts in language learning software.

## Texas A&M Could Hire Musk For "Aggie Loop"
Texas A&M is considering [hiring Elon Musk's The Boring Company](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j72OgzAQBp_GdEbrZYNN4eIaulx7Jdr4ByyZGBEHcm9_SvrrPumTZjQ_1-nKKaf7_M1rsPUVy8SupiNMCiRJpIkab2_gB9UEqzQaIELTNYv1JqIZFOsBXYgYuSfQEKO_6Y69CU2yCEgKgBRc-q5rSaHrjfaaFWrtnCAIPtWyt3UJNbz4EfNvOcLeurI22S61bg_RfQkcBY7nebZu2cv9_Qoc3TPX5x4EjrzX5PJ7fSCS5Sp5nlOQuZRNqsEouFDfbsvW7NZvZ8o5PXotCOaVU_7o6j_1h8W_AAAA____CVxJ) to build a tunnel connecting heavily trafficked areas of its sprawling campus to reduce congestion. The proposed all-electric "Aggie Loop" would [cost between $250 million and $350 million](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O8yAQAJ8Gd2vBmpikoEhDl0_6qistjDcxOn4sIHH89qdLf_VIo9F83aab9cGnxz8bSbf3PU_WNf-iSXCQgHKS3aJnvlxER1ooPHMp8Tx0q1aW5ovls7Mn6YRyanTER8fJDRxJqM5r5CgF51Lw0zgMvRToxrNalBWolHNMclp8y6VvKzV623oPR35R6V2OXdBra1tlw5WhYWj2fe9jTb-MoaEElhiamBMdDI3LcbPJU2VoPiqwEGErecuVKrRnShSgHrVRhHvJESjkBPFZv6HCnItPD3CZobEFrldRnv_XtSt62XYfgq-jYpI_ovXhE9f-ePXS-BMAAP__zLRt8w) and take three years to complete. Conceptual plans show two routes connecting classroom buildings, apartments, and the football stadium with six surface and three subsurface stations. In the last ten years, the school's enrollment has [jumped by 18,000](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOqzAQAL_G7ozs9YJJ4eI1dHntlWhjDFnJYGR8kPz96dJfP6PRfN3HO3HibflPa_T1NeeRQuUzjkYrVIAjysk_9HQzMnrjoNeI0Fv59HOL2Bu8gXOgjaWoHSHaGW07P7rWSvagAY3WaHTbWduggdD1bnJkwLkQBOo4cc2lqc9Y44uOOb3zGUsT8iqTf9a6H8L-EzAIGK7ramo8EhWq_EsIGD6S-t74jOXg-laPXHhbVMjrTttb0bJwVCnnXcAgi5_2i1Pio3MC9bISp0-q_nF-evgJAAD___1sW9g), and a July capacity study report noted that 20 minutes isn't enough time for students to travel from one end of campus to the other. Alternatives to the tunnel system include expanding the bus fleet and enhancing micro-mobility options like e-bikes and scooters.
## Police Searching for Fake Dentist
Authorities are looking for a woman on probation for multiple felony offenses in Harris and Galveston counties who has been charged with [practicing dentistry without a license](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQhJ_G7rBg4YyvoLjGXa690iKwjlfCYJmNSd7-lPR_N8WMNN_377bcPCXKj79-R8evtSw-MF24KCmMALOYPrq7jL9Vj05ZmKQxMOl-c_fVwqol-Clao63HEZSOqNVoTBhl6MmBBKOkNEr-GrUejIIwTjZar8DaEDojMRKXc-ANGV--ruldLjyHUPY-uY35qJ3-08HcwdxaG9bygnErz8olf0odzBlb7WD-zkUru8_Ch_CsGMVxflgC5YeImJkqn2_RiLfyZJEoYK4oItaDGMVxlrtnKllcVNI31f508WiUEtXRdkY-dk_pe45_cHU5-B8AAP__OnRwag). On probation since 2021, Juanetta Solomon, 41, allegedly [operated a business called Ismilez Cosmetic Designz](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtygzAQAL9GdPLocUa4UJGGzmlTMkI6wyUCMej8_PqM06feZne_zsM5UKZ1-gwLen5cyhAi0w0HrSRIAwM0yY8qnXSDXjvTKQDT2Wb2oFsEZ_GkNDh9Ui516MLoTOjsqDrXkDfKgFYKtDq21h5Am9h2LrmgjXMxClCYiMt-4BkZH6Fe8rPccD_EsjTZz8xbFfZDmF6YPoxR2zcRpt9KZWH672tYkTnIWnJZyipDjNeKSW77uyLSOsmEK1Pl_SkzRVwrSqoLZXzJWOqCTFEmrDStL_kT-Cl3jGVPVda53IXp9dG20AII0ze7T9udcqbaOgFqWgLlP1X-59zNm98AAAD__yMcchU) as Nikki Calloway and claimed to be a licensed dentist on TikTok, posting with the account "Tha_Toothly_Houston." A woman who paid Solomon $1,000 for veneers and a bridge told police that Solomon failed to take a mold of her teeth, applied harsh chemicals that made her dizzy, and used a drill and file to make the composite veneers fit. Although Solomon claimed she was indigent at a previous arraignment, she is free on bonds totaling more than $400,000. Austin ranks as the 14th most expensive city in the country, with an annual income of $122,229 needed to live comfortably. Dallas, Fort Worth, and Arlington all require between $90,043 and $93,482, while Houston requires $85,804 and San Antonio requires $80,175. El Paso is the most affordable large city in Texas, with an annual income of $74,721 needed to live comfortably.

Peter, Did you hear what President Obama said about fair maps? He was talking about the 2022 midterms and explaining why the “red wave” never crashed. If you remember, heading into the 2022 midterms, the media narrative suggested that Trump’s MAGA allies up and down the ballot were going to sweep state and local offices — and even potentially secure control of both the House _and_ the Senate. But Republicans failed to clinch the Senate and only won back control of the House with a narrow majority. **President Obama said, “What a lot of people didn’t mention (after the election) was because of the work that [Attorney General] Eric [Holder] and NDRC and others had done, we just had a better map. That’s part of the reason that we did not see a red wave. The state-level leaders we’re working to help elect will be the nuts and bolts that keep our democracy together and hold the line against Trump’s allies and their MAGA policies.
Their work is not glitzy — and the work you’re doing to help elect them can be unseen and pretty thankless. (So in case you haven’t heard today: _Thank you so much_.)

body:
Former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters given 9-year sentence by judge
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s7p8d563896)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s4i271a467f)**
| | Hi everyone,
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, October 4, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters given 9-year sentence by judge](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s6j6dcd5fb3)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s7v9ad28896)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/ses60506752)
Judge Matthew Barrett has sentenced former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters to 9 years of incarceration following a guilty verdict in her election integrity case.
She was sentenced to serve 8-1/2 years in prison with the Colorado Department of Corrections, and six months in the Mesa County Jail.
In a scathing rebuke of her defiant behavior after a guilty conviction, Barrett listed all the reasons that probation was not a possibility for Peters: “You are no hero...Yes, you are a charlatan...Incarceration is appropriate when a person is a danger to us all, by sword or by pen,” he said from the bench.
Peters called five witnesses who each spoke kindly of her, including Dallas Schroeder, a former Elbert County clerk and present commissioner.
“It’s with a heavy heart that I hear vile accusations and anger directed at me,” Peters said, asking the judge for probation.
Peters just had a heart to serve the public, she told the court. Following the sentencing, Peters was taken into custody.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s6h1be373f1)**
|
---
**[By diverting $641M to migrants, Mayorkas admits FEMA funds won’t last through hurricane season](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/seoc510191f)** [THE POST MILLENNIAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s0q0f7554a6)
* DHS Secretary Mayorkas admitted that FEMA funds will not last through the hurricane season after $641 million was diverted for shelters for non-citizen migrants.
* The fund diversion occurred prior to Hurricane Helene, which caused severe damage in the Southeast, killing at least 160 people.
* The Biden-Harris administration announced one-time payments of $750 for essentials to those affected, with additional disaster assistance to follow.
* The diversion of FEMA funds has sparked backlash, with critics calling out the government for prioritizing migrant aid over disaster relief for U.S. citizens.
* GOP and conservative voices have strongly criticized FEMA and DHS, accusing them of neglecting American citizens during a crisis.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/sat0596a9a7)**
|
---
**[Thousands of noncitizens removed from voter rolls, dozens of lawmakers want answers from Garland](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s8neb698c4a)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s4g833409a1)
* Over 70 lawmakers are urging the DOJ for information on efforts to prevent noncitizen voting in federal elections, citing concerns about election integrity.
* The lawmakers, led by Sen. Bill Hagerty and Rep. Andy Biggs, are demanding answers on how many noncitizens have been prosecuted for voting and what measures are in place to prevent noncitizen registration.
* Virginia and Texas identified thousands of noncitizens on their voter rolls, some of whom had voted, prompting further scrutiny.
* The DOJ recently charged an illegal immigrant with stealing a U.S. citizen’s identity to vote in multiple elections.
* Lawmakers are frustrated with the DOJ's lack of response to a previous inquiry on this issue, especially with the 2024 election approaching.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/seu4f8367aa)**
|
---
**[Dockworkers’ union reaches tentative agreement, will suspend port strike until January](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s8qc4bbef9d)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s3n8f09239e)
* U.S. dockworkers will return to work after reaching a tentative agreement with employers on a 62% wage increase, which is on the table for the next 90 days.
* The International Longshoremen’s Association, representing 45,000 workers, and the U.S. Maritime Alliance (USMX) will resume negotiations on other outstanding issues until January 15, 2025.
* The strike, which began over demands for better wages and concerns about automation, has been suspended with all work resuming immediately.
* The offer follows USMX’s previous proposal of a 50% wage increase over six years. The strike marked the first major dockworker strike in nearly 50 years.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/sbv1b1c5fcc)**
|

**[Colorado Democratic candidate spends campaign money on hair, clothes, makeup](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/s6mae06c7d6)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Vyg/sfsab74615b)
* Colorado Democratic Senate candidate Vivian Smotherman has spent over $1,000 of campaign contributions on personal appearance expenses, including clothes, hair, and makeup.
* State campaign finance laws do not explicitly prohibit these expenditures but state that contributions should not be used for personal purposes unrelated to the election. Smotherman consulted the Secretary of State’s office, which had no prior ruling on such expenses.
* The race for Senate District 6 is highly contested, with Democrats aiming to flip the seat for a veto-proof majority in the state Senate. Smotherman has raised $59,000, while her Republican opponent, Sen. Cleave Simpson, has raised $142,000, with significantly more funds left for the final month of the campaign.

* Proposition 131, which proposes ranked-choice voting (RCV) in Colorado, is criticized as a departure from the traditional one person/one vote system, with concerns it may invalidate votes and lead to confusion.
* In RCV, voters rank candidates, and if no one wins more than 50%, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and votes are redistributed, leading to potential complications in counting.
* Critics argue RCV can lead to outcomes where candidates with fewer votes initially can still win, and errors or confusion in filling out ballots could result in many votes being discarded.
* Concerns are raised about the high cost of implementing RCV, potential manipulation by wealthy donors, and the system's reliance on computers for vote counting.
* The article points out that prominent left-leaning figures support RCV, suggesting it could favor their political interests, and urges a "No" vote on Proposition 131.

Americans who increasingly favor socialism over capitalism.

Dear
Friend,
In recent
years, there has been a noticeable shift among young Americans
who increasingly favor socialism over capitalism. This trend
raises a critical question: do they fully understand these two
systems' historical contexts and real-world outcomes?

To
address this, we have created a new eBook, The History of
Socialism and Capitalism, authored by two of the most prominent
voices in today's political discourse, Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This new
eBook offers a deep dive into the origins, development, and
impacts of socialism and capitalism. Each scholar presents an
in-depth analysis through two different lenses. It's hard to
overstate the relevance of this eBook in today's policy debates,
where radical proposals are gaining traction.

Understanding the historical and practical implications of
socialism and capitalism is crucial for making informed decisions
about our economic and political future. The insights provided by
Ferguson and Hanson will equip you with the knowledge to
critically evaluate these competing ideologies and their
potential impact on society.

Don't
miss this opportunity to enhance your understanding of these
pivotal economic systems. Click here to request your free copy of
The History of Socialism and Capitalism today.

Greg

Hoover

eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the
Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research
organization that seeks to improve the human condition by
advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national
security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have
produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

**And 32 days from now, America will decide once more.** We're faced with two options: one that focuses on a brighter future that lives up to that promise, and another that prefers a past where it was too often retracted.
But this choice won't only be made when we select our next president. It's one we'll make in every race, up and down the ballot in every state.

But this choice won't only be made when we select our next president. It's one we'll make in every race, up and down the ballot in every state. So when it comes to Florida's Senate race, I choose Debbie Mucarsel-Powell.= | | | = As the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and a tireless advocate for her community, Debbie reflects the realizationof the American Dream and democratic values that I encourage us all to uphold. More than that: I trust her to keep our nation on the path of progress, where our nation's essential promise is extended to us all, in the U.S. Senate. I cannot say the same for her opponent, Rick Scott — someone whose positions, policies, and personality all point to the darkest departures from that promise: The grifts of the Gilded Age. The manic paranoia of the (original) McCarthy era. The relentless injustice of Reconstruction. So I'm reaching out to you now, friends, because Florida must now decide which path to follow. And in a race that could decide Senate control, Florida's choice could shape the next chapter of our story. Fortunately, the polls seem to indicate the tides are turning toward the path of righteousness that Debbie embodies. But another lesson history teaches us is that money talks. So against an opponent who wields our story to selfish ends, with enough wealth to blanket the airwaves with lies from now to Election Day, it's on all of us to ensure Debbie has the resources to rise above the noise, starting by reaching her $150,000 daily goal. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = We the people are about to make history. I hope you'll join us on the right side. Thank you, Ken Burns | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

Last year, during a routine anatomy scan at 19 weeks pregnant, Allie received the devastating news that the baby she was joyfully expecting, Miley Rose, was not going to make it.

Following the diagnosis, Doctors warned that continuing the pregnancy would endanger Allie’s life. But, **the Tennessee state legislature,_which is 85% male_ , had passed a near-total ban on abortion in 2022.** She was forced to leave her home state, devastated and heartbroken, to obtain the life-saving care she needed:

_“With a risk of sepsis, blood clots, or more, I underwent an emergency abortion. I did this alone: in a city I had never been to before, without my family or my husband there by my side,”_ Allie said.

However, her legislator, Rep. Jeff Burkhart, did not have any empathy for her experience. He told her that if his own daughter had been in her position, he’d have wanted her to _continue the pregnancy..._ he also told her “most of the time the pregnancies that go bad are usually the first pregnancy.” (???)

It’s way past time we elect legislators, not mansplainers who have no idea what they’re talking about.

Betches News recently published the audio from that conversation, _“In recently unearthed audio from June 2023, Republican Tennessee representative Jeff Burkhart is heard speaking to two women who had lost pregnancies. In the conversation he actively tried to invalidate their experiences because of his own misinformed understanding of reproductive health. Almost a year earlier, a ban on abortion from the point of conception with zero exceptions went into effect in Tennessee.”_

After the conversation, Phillips wrote to Buckhart and said, _“Every chance I get to tell my story, I will... Who knows, maybe one day I’ll run against you.”_

Another thing most people don't know is that Scrabble harkens back to the Great Depression. It was developed by an unemployed architect, and the first Scrabble factory was in an old schoolhouse in rural Connecticut where they produced 12 games an hour. The chairman of Macy's came across the game while on vacation, and the rest, as they say, is history.
Scrabble's success story reminds me of the American dream and all of the reasons our fight for the Dignity of Work is so important. The 1930s were a tough time for our country, but Franklin D. I'm fighting every day in the Senate to make sure progress for workers never stops – but I need your help to keep it up. Mitch McConnell and the GOP are all in to defeat me because this race could decide Senate control – so I'm counting on folks like you to help me compete.

There was something so warm and welcoming about the Sunshine State — and I knew "All Too Well" that this would eventually be my home, too. I've had the incredible privilege of building a beautiful life here. This is where I fell in love, raised a family of my own, and began dedicating my career to serving this state. I've helped to protect Florida's wildlife, preserve our coral reefs, and lead new programs to improve access to affordable health care for Floridians — and this was all before I even ran for office and became the first South American in Congress. In the House:
* I wrote the bill to expand seniors' Medicare Advantage coverage to ensure more Americans could get the care they deserve;
* I worked with Republicans to provide economic relief to families and small businesses;
* I secured $200 million for Everglades restoration; and
* I fought tirelessly for commonsense gun safety reforms and served as the vice chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force.

I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. Friend, he really is "The Smallest Man Who Ever Lived." While I'm fighting to improve Florida, he's focused on taking away our rights and freedoms. Listen, _I know_ the tides are turning and Florida is ready to finally flip blue. I can see it in the polling data: Rick Scott's approval rating is going down, while I'm catching up to him in the polls. But it doesn't change the fact that I'm going up again his million-dollar fortune — and right now, he's putting everything he's got into defeating me. So, friend, I'm counting on you to choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda. So here's my final question for you: "...Ready For It?" **[Will you chip in $10 — or whatever you can spare before midnight tonight — to split with Defeat Boebert PAC and help me defeat Rick Scott, body:
We must make McConnell pay a price for meddling in Michigan
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2017%2E135344%2E1G7DK6)

Friend -
In just a moment, we are going to ask you to make a donation to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan. Please let us explain why this request – especially today – is so important.
Here's the truth:
We've told you about Mitch McConnell's $22.5 million super PAC buy in Michigan -- the one they're hoping will catch us off guard and deliver this race for our Republican opponent.
But here's why your donation in response is so important.
First and most obviously, we need the resources to fight back. $22.5 million is a lot of money and if we just sit back and take it without responding, Elissa is going to lose.
The bigger piece may be this:
Believe it or not, we have one final FEC fundraising deadline on October 16. And when it's done, we'll again file a report showing what we've raised.
Our opponents – including Mitch McConnell's super PAC – will see what we raised day-by-day during this month, including in the days since he announced his ads.
We want to put up a monster number. The kind of number that makes them think twice before spending more. Because if they know there's a price to pay for meddling in Michigan, maybe that will be the end of the spending against us.
And if that happens, we'll be in an even better position to win.
[**Our average online donation is $40. Some give more, many give less. body:
We know we’ve asked a lot of you, and we know lots of other campaigns and causes are sending a ton of emails and texts your way. But we need to turn this around to have any chance at victory in Arizona.
#

body:
But they’re not doing anything to fix it
#

Friends -
Republicans love to talk about crime.
They love to blame it on immigrants. They love to blame it on mental health issues. And they love to blame it on the Biden-Harris administration.
But what Republicans fail to mention is that according to FBI data, from 2022 to 2023 our country had the largest decline in murders in _decades._ So far this year, violent crime has continued to steadily decline. And yes, all of this was under President Biden’s leadership.
**_In contrast, homicides rose by over 30 percent under Donald Trump._**
If Republicans are concerned about violent crime, then working across the aisle to end our nation’s gun violence crisis should be their number one priority. Instead, we have extreme members of the House and Senate who are **blocking** votes on lifesaving gun safety legislation—all for the sake of keeping the gun lobby happy.
One of the best ways to fight crime is to enact commonsense gun safety legislation. But if we want this to happen, we must replace gun lobby-backed elected officials with gun violence prevention champions.

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6b5c953bf3a7428b8c409259c41e7001&_e=X36HpcKMuXT32-_cvyyV1hyc1_xSppJFoW9p8j3ubhIz6NX_2imQuKPF_lS-6aTX9S2X6qzgcHig_8S7ovhPm7D0Atdi5z-ORlE2LriznctrtkGkwqokhtQbNPM4mtA6zO6IiCaR4kNSlzr70DRiB4-zSAeak4zzit3bR4FdBneAzesH-dHYXMVAP1pW-P4PV0Q31nyw-yeA-SjpHMiY-l_syALKB-zKfgRcyQOo25aQI5fauy1Ail8lwNqCAnQ2yweMr3BV8zieCFys-vqf1FfHA93xfOjCZ_6sWsNVEiKgoRkxCR0qwYKi9VN_WggtG7dnScf5u5IZET6S4BVDAwSkx9VxwYxQXfP1rRl8D1PtZGFUNFLLc9d0gMK2hosfm2VASSRmdLA--nW7I5T-3pObxTDHWpjc3XAjwgPVmog%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

Dear Fellow Conservative,

I'll bet you've heard this one before: voter fraud doesn't exist--it's just a ploy.

That's the baseless narrative constantly pushed by Leftists politicians, liberal fanatics, and their mainstream media mouthpiece.

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges — from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20 or whatever feels right to you today directly to Tim Kaine's Senate campaign in Virginia and Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? I would not be reaching out were it not so important. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]

Whatever Josh Hawley is fighting for... that’s something else.
#
Peter,
**John Goodman is a born-and-raised Missourian who knows real family values.**
He learned them the same way I did, by growing up in a beautiful community where people took care of each other — through good times and tough times.
**_[Watch this message from John Goodman, then please chip in $10 to help me replace Josh Hawley and restore real family values in the Senate >>>](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75023?refcode=em20241004-7921&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7921%2E614464%2EeD_sLS)_**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75023?refcode=em20241004-7921&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7921%2E614464%2EeD_sLS)
**[WATCH + CHIP IN →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75023?refcode=em20241004-7921&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7921%2E614464%2EeD_sLS)**
**Josh Hawley has spent six years trying to convince us that he’s an authority on real family values — but we all know that couldn’t be further from the truth.**
While towns and neighborhoods in Missouri continue to suffer from corporate price gouging, outsourcing, and economic divestment, **Josh Hawley has been focused on... something else.**
He wrote a weird self-help book called “Manhood,” lecturing all of us about how we need to be made in his own creepy image. He’s enriched himself while failing to bring ANY money home for the rest of our state. He forced Missouri taxpayers to foot the $250,000 bill for his own lawbreaking. And even more recently he’s proudly admitted to “advocating Christian nationalism.”
Hawley doesn’t want to represent us — he just wants to rule us. He wants to control how we build and raise our families. He wants to control what happens in our bedroom, in our workplace, in our doctor’s office, and even our bodies.
**I’m running to replace Josh Hawley and restore real family values in the Senate** — to empower working people, to make real investments into our communities, and to put everyday Missourians in charge of their own bodies, families, and lives.
Protecting these values starts with defeating Josh Hawley — and with multiple polls showing this race getting closer by the day, I know we have a real chance to make it happen this year, Peter. So I’m asking:
[**Will you stand with me and John Goodman by rushing a donation of any amount to my campaign today? If we have the resources to get messages like this one in front of as many Missouri voters as possible, I know we can defeat Hawley and take back power for working families on November 5th.**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75023?refcode=em20241004-7921&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7921%2E614464%2EeD_sLS)

name: Kamala Harris for President
subject: It stinks. Big time.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
If you're anything like us, your inbox and text messages are filled with campaigns and organizations asking for donations. | | |
---
Peter -- if you're anything like us, your inbox and text messages are filled with campaigns and organizations asking for donations. But the sad reality is that a few of those groups make it look like your donation is going to elect Kamala, when really they are just keeping the money for themselves. Here's one way to spot them: Our campaign will _never_ do a quadruple match or anything like it. We avoid those. It stinks. Big time. People just want to chip in a few bucks to help defeat Trump, and their money is actually going elsewhere. Our campaign has probably lost tens of millions of dollars because of it. And with close races in so many battleground states, that would be more than enough to make the difference. We don't have a record of you donating yet, Peter, and we sincerely hope you haven't given elsewhere hoping it was going to us. But we have to make up for that lost revenue. Because like we said, in states settled by only a few thousand votes, those funds are critical in reaching undecided voters or Democrats who don't vote in every election. So, please: [**Contribute directly to Kamala Harris's campaign before our final FEC fundraising deadline of the campaign ends soon. clean_body: If you're anything like us, your inbox and text messages are filled with campaigns and organizations asking for donations. | | | Peter -- if you're anything like us, your inbox and text messages are filled with campaigns and organizations asking for donations. But the sad reality is that a few of those groups make it look like your donation is going to elect Kamala, when really they are just keeping the money for themselves. Here's one way to spot them: Our campaign will never do a quadruple match or anything like it. We avoid those. It stinks. Big time. People just want to chip in a few bucks to help defeat Trump, and their money is actually going elsewhere. Our campaign has probably lost tens of millions of dollars because of it. And with close races in so many battleground states, that would be more than enough to make the difference. We don't have a record of you donating yet, Peter, and we sincerely hope you haven't given elsewhere hoping it was going to us. But we have to make up for that lost revenue. Because like we said, in states settled by only a few thousand votes, those funds are critical in reaching undecided voters or Democrats who don't vote in every election. So, please: If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Thank you, Kamala Harris for President | | | |

Peter, we cannot get complacent ahead of November.

Some day we won't have to say this anymore, but the reality is that there are critical elections across the country in just a few weeks , with the future of voting rights, abortion, and more in the balance.
Opponents of voting rights have long worked behind the scenes to make it more difficult to vote . The MAGA movement is pushing hard to bring back the bad old days with limited early voting, reduced voting hours, more restrictions on mail-in ballots, and anything else they can ram through if they take control.
The vote suppressors have spent years honing their playbook for important states and elections. They have the advantage over us in both money and time.

I recently visited Philadelphia to campaign for my good friend and colleague Bob Casey — because he’s in the toughest race of his career, and we all need to do everything we can to make sure he wins. Our Senate Majority depends on it.
**[Before I share more, if you’re able, please chip in whatever you can to his campaign today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241004-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20241004-1&refcode2=4444_552475_8qsudn&akid=4444%2E552475%2E8qsudn)**

name: Jerry Evans
subject: THANK YOU!
body:
WE DID IT!
| | | |
---
Friend,
I just wanted to personally thank everyone who chipped in and helped us close out the quarter strong earlier this week. Because of your help, we will better be able to get the message out about my opponent's record.
My opponent, Bill Foster, has spent nearly 15 years in the U.S. Congress. Personally, I believe that is too long. To make matters worse, he is now talking about raising taxes and has claimed that the porous southern border has been "solved", which we all know is not the case. It needs to be said that Bill Foster, along with many others in Congress on both sides, have continuously overspent for decades, causing rampant inflation and a skyrocketing debt that we must get under control.
I pledge to you now that in Congress, I will vote to close the southern border, begin to pay off the National Debt, lower the prices of goods and make the American Dream of owning a home accessible to everyone.
As you all know, I am a small business owner and educator and I have no intention of serving in Congress for a decade or more. I want to serve my community and return home to raise my children and run my business. That's the way the founders intended.
Thank you again to all who have donated or if you are not able to, for your prayers. body:

---
Derek, Do you want to know one of the single most effective things you can do to elect Kamala Harris the next president of the United States and Democrats to critical offices nationwide? **_Talk to voters._** We need strong Kamala supporters in Pennsylvania to step up right now to talk to voters in your community this weekend. **And the best news is, we have HUNDREDS of opportunities across Pennsylvania to talk to voters between now and Election Day. Check it out:** | Events near: 18326 [Wrong zip code? Let us know!](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/2024_update_contact_information/?t=1&akid=1725%2E22930333%2EmnQM7F)

**[Can't make any of these events? Find many more opportunities to get involved in your community at go.kamalaharris.com](https://ak.democrats.org/go/7205?t=4&akid=1725%2E22930333%2EmnQM7F)**

**Derek, the elections in 2016 and 2020 all came down to a few thousand votes in key battleground states just like Pennsylvania. None of us want to wake up on November 6 wishing we had done more.**

Thanks for all that you do,
The Democrats

Tim Walz directly asked JD Vance whether Donald Trump lost the 2020 election, and... Vance refused to say yes. Instead, he dodged the question and refused to say whether he believes Donald Trump lost the election. The implications of this are staggering. The vice-presidential candidate for one of our country's two largest political parties refuses to go on the record about whether our elections are legitimate, and that should terrify everyone. What was once upon a time a fringe belief of the far right has made its way into the mainstream ideology of Donald Trump's Republican Party. Each of us who cares about protecting the bedrock of our democracy and basic freedoms should be very afraid for the future of our country if Donald Trump re-enters the White House with a Vice President who lacks the smallest ounce of courage to tell basic truths to the American people. I am very afraid for that future if Donald Trump is surrounded by more and more yes-men and is unconstrained by a Supreme Court he hand-picked that has granted him full immunity. I am very afraid for that future when the Republican nominee for Vice President refuses to acknowledge the lies of the past. As Tim Walz aptly put it, Vance gave an incredibly damning non-answer. This week's debate was a solemn reminder that this is no normal election and the stakes have never been higher. What if we told you Mitch McConnell just dropped $22.5 million into Michigan in order to defeat us?

If that wasn't enough - if we lose in Michigan, it's almost a sure thing Kamala Harris does as well. And if that happens, Democrats lose the Senate and White House.

name: Neil Parrott
subject: Frederick Co. Forum Sunday!
body:
The campaign is going full speed ahead. Our first forum is this Sunday | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=0bef071f3b)

|

| | In This email:
1) Forum this Sunday - watch in person or online
2) Help the People of North Carolina
3) City of Frederick - Stop Non-Citizens from Voting Referendum Petition
4) Annapolis Fundraiser

Peter, This Sunday, my opponent and I will participate in the first Forum.

Could you be there?

The stakes have never been higher. We have a choice between:
1. Continuing Biden-era policies with high inflation, a completely open border, and having no say in your child's education, and
2. Making the hard financial decisions to cut spending to reduce inflation, securing our border, and prioritizing the parents' wishes, rather than bureaucrats' agendas, for your child's education.

**League of Women Voters Congressional Forum - District 6
Sunday, October 6, 2-4:30pm, Hood College, **
Rosenstock Hall at the south end of the campus.
Online, the event can be watched at 3 PM by clicking [here.](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=2abad0cc48&e=5a45ee1154)
Ultimately, this election is not about me, but about the direction of our country. If you can come to Hood College this Sunday, please do, and bring a friend. If you need a green shirt, please let me know!
---

| HELP THE PEOPLE OF NORTH CAROLINA -
SUPPLIES COLLECTION
Today, Friday, and tomorrow, Saturday, October 5, Senator Bill Folden will be collecting supplies and donations at Stauffer's Funeral Home, 1621 Opossumtown Pike, Frederick, to take down to help the people of North Carolina who have lost everything after this week's hurricane. The supplies will be driven down to North Carolina on Sunday.

Senator Folden has spoken with a North Carolina State Senator who will be distributing the supplies. She indicated that the items most needed are:
* Water,
* Canned goods,
* Non-perishable food items,
* Diapers

April and I will be bringing jugs of water over today. Knowing my wife, we'll probably be bringing food, too.

**CITY OF FREDERICK RESIDENTS - KEEP READING!**
---
| [DONATE TO KEEP THIS COMMERCIAL ON THE AIR](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=f9ab796f4b&e=5a45ee1154 "DONATE TO KEEP THIS COMMERCIAL ON THE AIR")

---
| URGENT PETITION \- NON-CITIZEN VOTING IN FREDERICK CITY
#### From the website **www.frederickvoter.com:**
On September 19th, 2024, four City Aldermen decided to allow noncitizens to vote in City of Frederick elections. That means noncitizens can also be elected Mayor or City Council (new name of Aldermen). We say that Frederick City voters should decide, and not just four Aldermen.
You have until October 28 to collect 15,000 signatures on a petition which would allow people in Frederick to decide if they want this new law.

Frederick City residents should be able to decide if they want for non-citizens, people who immigrated to our country illegally, to be able to vote in City elections. It is against Federal law for non-citizens to vote in our Federal elections.
---
| [DONATE FOR THE FUTURE OF OUR COUNTRY](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=859f9f4cca&e=5a45ee1154 "DONATE FOR THE FUTURE OF OUR COUNTRY")
---
| Thank you for caring about our country...and for being willing to take action.

You've got 3 chances this weekend to make a difference:
1. Come to the Forum on Sunday, 2-4:30pm at Hood College,
2. Go to www.Frederickvoter.com to help with the petition effort,
3. Bring supplies for the North Carolina Relief effort.

I look forward to talking with you soon,
Neil

P.S. For those of you who like to plan, we have an event coming up soon in Annapolis. April and I would love to see you there!

| | I want to thank everyone on our grassroots team for stepping up in a big way in September. **I dubbed last month "Save the Senate September" because we all know how critical it is that we hold the Democratic Senate Majority for future President Kamala Harris.** If we lose the Senate, Republicans like Mitch McConnell and whoever succeeds him as their caucus leader will stop at nothing to stymie progress on affordable housing, protecting our planet, reproductive rights, safeguarding Social Security, and more Our team proved that we're ready to win big in November. Thanks to support from people like you, our grassroots team collectively raised almost $25,000 online for Democrats in competitive Senate races across the country. **Incumbents like Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown and Democratic nominees like Ruben Gallego and Angela Alsobrooks will use the resources we've helped them raise to engage voters to win against their MAGA opponents.** Time and time again, you've shown that the strength and commitment of our team is what makes us unstoppable. I know we can keep up this momentum to power us to victory in November. In this final month, there are two states where polls have unexpectedly shown us that we are a few points away — Texas and Florida. They're a stretch for sure, but sometimes you need to capitalize on the unexpected moments, and one of these states could be the miracle that gives us the 50th vote in the Senate. **These two seats are currently filled with red incumbents, but let's give each of these Democratic candidates a boost. **I’ll have more to say about each race in future emails. I’ve raised enough campaign resources to conduct statewide outreach to people who vote during the absentee ballot period. Now, I need to expand our outreach to people who vote on election day at the polls.
I need your help more now than ever.
