name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Putting a puzzle together
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
Housing is a human right. |
#
This is Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Senator Tina Smith and I have received a lot of questions since we introduced our plan to fight the housing crisis by creating a federal housing authority to finance and build millions of homes across America: the **Homes Act.** One question in particular — “Why would the bill cap rent at 25% of a household’s adjusted gross income?” — stuck out to me as one of the things that I find to be so fun about legislation (dare I say). When it actually comes to bringing a vision of the world to life, **a lot of times it’s like putting a puzzle together**. We have to answer very refined questions: Why this amount of money? What is sustainable? For that 25% cap, the question for us was: What amount is **audacious, but also within striking distance of building a political coalition** to pass the House _and_ the Senate? What amount gets us that mix of deeply affordable, integrated communities that would garner _public_ support? **Public goods are their strongest and most resilient — in a policy sense, and politically — when they are integrated.** That’s why I believe social housing should be widely accessible. Like food or healthcare, **housing is a human right**. We are fighting now against privatization of the housing market and for the creation of good, union jobs to build homes that last — and are affordable to all. **[Will you split a $2 contribution today — $1 for each of our teams — so that we can keep pushing to give millions of Americans a safe, comfortable and affordable place to call home?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94268859/503048235/-75650819?amount=2&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241004_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMjk1N2VlMC03MDgyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sUj54bsVQd6wnRp_Uikecp4AdbzMknrYNr9BbOeLrjY=)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94268860/503048236/-75650819?refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241004_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMjk1N2VlMC03MDgyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sUj54bsVQd6wnRp_Uikecp4AdbzMknrYNr9BbOeLrjY=)
---
I also believe that being able to age or raise a family in the same place is _profoundly_ important.
Community is sacred. It’s just good for the country to be able to walk outside, and have neighbors you’ve known since you were a kid. **This is a big part of what the privatization of the housing market has actually taken from us: a culture of continuity and community.**
It’s actually eroding our social fabric, which then supercharges the potency of divisive tactics and other things we see weaponized by the right in our politics.
But together, we’ve built a movement fighting for protecting our community values — from expanding affordable, accessible healthcare to enshrining housing as a human right.

Dear Friend,
---
We've seen time and time again that the Lord has established the steps of Let Us Worship, and has conformed our plans to His will. Time after time, God led us INTO THE HEART of the heartbreak, where His presence is needed most. The images coming out wake of Hurricane Helene are heartbreaking. Entire communities have been wiped out and peoples lives have been up ended. subject: We made a difficult decision

body:

Hi Peter — Our
campaign just made a risky decision, and I wanted you to hear about it
from me.

Here’s the context: Republicans have launched nasty attack ads against me
to mislead voters and stir up support for my right-wing opponent — and
Mitch McConnell's super PAC launched a $17 million ad blitz on top of that
to drown our campaign out.

The scary thing is, their strategy may be working.

FOUR recent polls show me statistically tied with Eric Hovde, and
RealClearPolitics just downgraded our race to a “Toss Up.”

If we let the GOP’s misleading attacks go unanswered, Hovde will continue
to surge in the polls and inch ahead in this all-important Senate race.

To fight back, our campaign just launched new ads of our own to set the
record straight.

Let me be clear: this was a risky decision. The money wasn’t originally in
the budget, but I gave the green light anyway.

That means we’re facing a budget deficit — and an uphill battle to keep
these ads on the air and reach as many voters as possible across
Wisconsin.

This was a tough call,
Peter. But I
felt confident taking the risk because I knew I could count on this
grassroots team to step up and have my back.

# Hello Peter!
---
|
Wow how time flies! Can you believe we are only a month away from one of the most pivotal elections in our nation's history?
As a campaign we are truly in crunch time. Everything we have been working towards comes down to this next month.
From the incredible enthusiasm I have seen all across our district, I know we are all putting in the work to make sure that Vice President Harris becomes our next President. But if she is going to pass the historic legislation she’s campaigning on, we must protect this critical battleground seat, take back the US House, and elect Hakeem Jeffries as our next Speaker.
Help me ensure that happens!
Over the next 30 days, my campaign is teaming up with Democratic candidates in communities across the 4th Congressional District. If we don’t ensure each and everyone one of our supporters cast their ballot, we won’t have the governing majority we need to protect reproductive rights, access to affordable healthcare, and the voting rights that are core to our democracy.
Keep reading to see how you can help make a change as we all work together to build a country that works for all of us.
---
|
---
|
# Volunteer Opportunities
We have several exciting volunteer opportunities coming up, and we would love for you to be a part of them. Whether you have a few hours to spare or can commit to helping on a weekly basis, your help is invaluable to us!
**Canvasses** Help engage voters for the 2024 election through direct conversations about what is at stake this election. This is a great way to engage with your local community and spread our campiagn’s message.
**Eugene Canvass with Lisa Fragala**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 10:00am
* Location: IAFF Firefighters Union Hall 160 Madison St, Eugene, OR 97402

**Springfield Canvass with Val Hoyle & John Lively**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 11am
* Location: Jack B Lively Memorial Park 6100 Thurston Rd Springfield, OR 97478

**Corvallis Canvass**
* Date and Time: Saturday September 28th at 10am
* Location: Benton County Democrats Office 425 SW Suite D Madison Ave Corvallis, OR 97333

**Philomath Canvass with Christopher McMorran**
* Date and Time: Sunday October 6th at 10:00am
* Location: Philomath City Park 299 S 23rd St, Philomath, OR 97370 Philomath, OR 97370

**Coos Bay Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday at 9:00am
* Location: 791 Virginia Ave North Bend, OR 97459

**Brookings Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday at 10:00am
* Location: Curry Democrats 619 Chetco Ave Brookings, OR 97415

**Gold Beach Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday at 10:00am
* Location: RSVP for location

**Port Orford Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday at 10:00am
* Location: RSVP for location

**Phone banking for Volunteers** Help our campaign recruit more volunteers by joining our phone bank. We’ll be reaching out to past volunteers and ask them to get involved this cycle.
* Date and Time: Every Wednesday at 6:00pm
* Location: Zoom-RVSP for the link!

* Location: RSVP

* Date and Time: Wednesday October 9th at 2:00pm
* Location: RSVP

[RSVP](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=621c574246&e=9659e2eb5e)

| **Lawn Signs**
If you would like a Val Hoyle Lawn Sign, you can either pick one up in person from your local County Democratic Party Headquarters or you can sign up on our website for one.
---
[Request a Lawn Sign](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=3abdceb461&e=9659e2eb5e)
|
---
| **Message from the Congresswoman**
---
| I hope you enjoyed watching the 2024 vice presidential debate as much as I did. I was thrilled to see Gov. Tim Walz remind Americans that he is the only candidate ready to protect our democracy and stand behind the votes of the people. Americans saw exactly what kind of Vice President he’ll be.
I’m thrilled to be back in Oregon after fighting in DC to avert a government shutdown. From now through Election Day, I’ll be at canvass launches, meeting with local elected officials and Democratic candidates, and talking directly with voters to ensure we get Oregonians to vote!
Next weekend, I will be joining volunteers as we knock on doors and talk with voters around the district. I hope you’ll join me!
With one month left, it’s time for all hands on deck. Every ounce of effort we put in matters!
Sincerely,

name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: Lower interest rates. Now what?
body:
| Hi Peter, The Federal Reserve recently voted to cut interest rates, shaving 0.5% off the benchmark .1 Markets rallied exuberantly at the news, reaching new highs.2 **Why did the Federal Reserve cut rates?** With inflation on a strong downward trajectory and concerns about economic weakness rising, the Fed clearly decided now was the right time to cut. The size of the cut was a surprise to many, who expected a quarter-point cut and could indicate that the Fed feels strong action is warranted. Some analysts believe lowering interest rates will lower the risk of a recession and increase the odds of a "soft landing" for the economy.3 **What do lower rates mean?** The Fed is responsible for setting the benchmark interest rate that all other borrowing rates follow. A lower benchmark will reduce borrowing costs for businesses and consumers, helping economic growth accelerate in the months to come.
---
|
---
The chart above shows interest rate trends over the last four years. You can see that while commercial rates don't change immediately after a rate cut, they generally follow the same trend. Going forward, mortgages will become cheaper, likely boosting the real estate market. Business borrowing costs will drop, giving a bump to industries like technology, which rely on credit to fund R&D.; Historically, stocks have tended to do well when rates drop.4 However, past performance doesn't predict the future and there's no guarantee that equities will follow any conventional path. Today's volatile markets are still grappling with post-pandemic distortions and are dominated by high-flying tech stocks.
---
|
---
**What could happen next?** Markets have rallied strongly in 2024, largely on hopes of lower interest rates. Now that the Fed has finally cut rates, it's likely that traders will turn their attention to other factors. We expect the presidential election to come into focus as we approach November. Analysts will also be closely reading economic reports for hints about recession risks and economic growth in 2025. All told, we're expecting plenty of volatility ahead. We're watching closely and researching different market scenarios for Q4 and 2025. I'll update you as needed and reach out individually if your strategies need to change. In the meantime, if you have any questions or concerns, hit "reply" and let me know. That's why I'm here. Sincerely,
---

Hello, After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress. We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes. = Ultimately, though, after all the votes were counted, Adam came up short. We lost to Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and with Lauren Boebert now out of the race, I know he can win this time. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022. During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars. It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads. If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and win this critical House seat, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now. ---
| **_In case you missed it..._**

[**Duarte debates empty podium, Gray skips Mendota’s Spanish-language debate**](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=1c5f842048&e=76a47b375f)
The San Joaquin Valley Sun
Reid Stone
11/03/2024

Latino voters in the hotly-contested 13th Congressional District fumed over former Asm. Adam Gray’s (D–Merced) decision to skip out on the nationally-watched race’s sole Spanish-translated debate.

[...]

**What they’re saying:** Mendota Mayor Victor Martinez was not surprised Gray did not attend the debate.
* “It’s not a surprise that Adam Gray did not show up for our Latino community,” Martinez said. “He never does. That’s why I’m supporting Congressman Duarte. He is always here for us when we need him. Our community is behind John because he supports us.”
* Other 13th District voters agreed with Martinez, arguing that the ex-Assemblyman’s no-show indicates Gray does not care about the Latino community.
* “He turns his back on the Latino community every chance he gets,” voter Alex Chavez said. “Just look at his ads, they have fancy sheriffs, big farmers, and rich guys, but never people who look like me. Adam Gray isn’t for the Latino community and everyone knows it.”
* Voter Yoshi Trujillo said, “Makes sense that Adam Gray didn’t show up tonight. Sure, it’s the only opportunity for people in our community to hear from him in our language, but that isn’t important to him clearly. He has lost a lot of support from people around here who know that he doesn’t like our Latino community.”

| | | Sorry to intrude into your inbox like this, but I have two reasons for emailing you:
1. _**[To tell you a bit about who I am and why this one House seat matters for the entire country.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0a11e0e6966d4618baa9a0f775945210&_e=_UkY7V_OBv2_svoSVa_JbAdxe4IFiAx07N4gzAvemFn9gO_D3kurhp2uC4nScx6bFhz0f8mqxhK3DYhKZ79DrcxVMVFE4TxR1Xb8IVX8ozXWyMVs2fLpKjEReUFGRWvGmkzsTQ1Db_Hfx1pio5zKFIQYak_W4wODPdU4-xNiOSofswEiyVZXbH_VHKu3VoTbkwBKINAf4v_JIHj5-tTAsm6z5VO0fYg7D4-xMWXav7ZqDZB9hoxpeHGvsMC5ZBOqQrT7rlbvMvF4EkXtcbR7gRrnpW_mtzJ2hafV-3TjFYOBb9hVRc9i3Iehqm-d7oVZFR_GWPYoKHMD931QYPrH5tXeELJwkyJOPxuZD_Aqhz6d2YWoBobDLvAWKlkT844ARBdPpCqqx3tHc94Uk58k1iNuQ9XkVYXH0aFbnDp_wETnJ6lPBqQ0GzFl6HOg1gSw1YeFEfG4hJVXXd4KxE4kKA%3D%3D "To tell you a bit about who I am and why this one House seat matters for the entire country.")**_
2. To tell you about the REAL piece of work heading to Congress if I don't win.

Hi, I'm Derrick Anderson. I'm a Trump-endorsed Green Beret who served as a Platoon Leader during "The Surge" in Iraq, then guarded Arlington National Cemetery back home in Virginia.

Then everything changed for me. Watching Biden/Harris betray a generation of U.S. servicemembers by surrendering Afghanistan to terrorists for cheap political points - that was a bridge too far for me.

_So I put together a team, filed my paperwork, and launched my campaign for Congress._

I knew this race was going to be tough. It's a purple district. The margins are razor-thin. And the Democrat Machine has unloaded tens of millions to keep it blue. But now it's an open seat - that means Republicans have a massive opportunity to flip it.

**This race will also be the FIRST MAJOR BELLWETHER of what 's to come. If we can win it quick and decisively, it could set in motion the biggest Republican victory in American history! **

# Debate in New York
---
In a striking contrast from the U.S. Presidential Debate last month, the Vice Presidential Debate on Tuesday night was relatively civil with microphones only being muted one time (shocking, we know!) Unlike his running mate, the republican vice presidential nominee pronounced the democratic candidate’s first name correctly and referred to his opponent by his title (more shocks!) The debate itself focused mainly on domestic issues and its most heated subjects surrounded abortion care and the January 6th attacks on the U.S. Capital. When asked about his running mate’s actions after losing the 2020 presidential race, the republican vice presidential nominee seemed to dart the question and instead say he is “focused on the future.” As for abortion care, the democratic vice presidential nominee stood strong in upholding the belief that reproductive care should be available nationwide, while the republican vice presidential nominee stood firm that it should stay a state issue.

Peter,

When abortion is on the ballot, _it wins. _

body:

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges — from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
I also have a personal connection to this race. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20, or whatever feels right to you today directly to Tobias Read and Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? I would not be reaching out were it not so important. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-slotkin?refcode=241004em-kenburnsRS]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-slotkin?refcode=241004em-kenburnsRS]
Democrats cannot keep control of the Senate if they lose in Michigan. Thank you for helping Elissa with your donation today.
Ken Burns

subject: We shouldn't have to beg our own government to help its own citizens.
body:
We deserve representatives who save lives at home and abroad. | | |
---
Friend, We’re nearing a year of U.S.-backed war crimes against Palestinians, and now the Biden administration is enabling a wider regional war. In the past two weeks, Israel’s attacks have killed over 1,300 people in Lebanon, including 90 children. After displacing 2 million people in Gaza without facing any consequences, Israel’s government has now displaced over 1 million people in Lebanon. The Israeli military is using the same tactics in Lebanon as in Palestine, leveling entire neighborhoods with “bunker buster” bombs, destroying roads and other civilian infrastructure like medical centers, and killing doctors and rescue workers. My congressional district is home to one of the largest and most vibrant Lebanese communities in the United States. **For over a week my team and I have been responding to heartbreaking calls, supporting 148 American families with ties to our district in their desperate attempts to evacuate from Lebanon.** A new mom of a 5-month-old is trying to get her child an emergency passport. A veteran broke down in tears asking, _“Do my two purple hearts mean anything to my country?”_ Already a father of four from Dearborn Michigan was killed by Israeli bombs. Family after family is saying: Please don’t leave us here and please stop bombing us. **We shouldn't have to beg our own government to help its own citizens.** The mission of the U.S. State Department is to protect Americans, and they are failing. Our government knew this was coming and had no plan to get Americans out. Meanwhile, millions of Americans in six states are dealing with the devastation of Hurricane Helene, with more than 200 people dead, entire towns and roads and bridges wiped away, and thousands still stranded without necessities like water or food. As the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) announced it needs $9 billion to adequately support hurricane recovery efforts last week, the Israeli military announced on the same day that it got an $8.7 billion aid package from the U.S. government. **We deserve better from our government. Instead of wasting trillions of our tax dollars on war, our government should fund what communities need here.** We deserve representatives who understand that saving lives at home and abroad is interconnected. **We deserve public officials who see all of us as human beings who deserve to live** , including Muslim Americans and Arab Americans who’ve experienced a frightening rise in violent hate crimes. I created the Rooted in Community Leadership PAC to counter the money from fossil fuel CEOs, the weapons industry, and MAGA billionaires who are trying to uphold the unjust status quo by interfering in our elections. body:
The choice is clear after last night. Stand with Bob Casey now!
#
Last night, something incredible happened in Harrisburg, Derek.
Bob Casey stepped onto that debate stage and showed Pennsylvania exactly what real leadership looks like. (Glad one of us finally had a fantastic debate in Harrisburg 😅)
The contrast couldn’t be clearer: Bob Casey is fighting for us. David McCormick is just fighting for himself.
Bob laid out a clear vision for Pennsylvania:
* Fighting corporate greed
* Building an economy that works for everyone
* Protecting our fundamental freedoms (voting rights, workers' rights, and women's rights)

Meanwhile, David McCormick? He was too busy twisting the truth and dodging questions. Classic move from someone who’d rather help his bottom line than help his neighbors in Pennsylvania.
So now, we’ve got to get to work. 💪 We’re in the final sprint to Election Day, and we need your help to keep Pennsylvania and the Senate Blue.
**[I have to ask – Will you rush a $5 donation right now to help Bob Casey cross the finish line and defeat McCormick on Election Day?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241004?refcode=em20241004-9449&refcode2=9449_434096_J9u5Mq&akid=9449%2E434096%2EJ9u5Mq)**

With less than 31 days until Election Day and Pennsylvanians already casting their ballots, our window to reach voters is closing fast. We can't afford to let McCormick and his super PAC million$ buy this Senate seat.
Let's send a message: Pennsylvania isn't for sale!
Thank you!!!

❤️ John

U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

Friend -- **_"What kind of peace do I mean? What kind of peace do we seek? Not a Pax Americana enforced on the world by American weapons of war. Not the peace of the grave or the security of the slave. I am talking about genuine peace, the kind of peace that makes life on earth worth living, the kind that enables men and nations to grow and to hope and to build a better life for their children--not merely peace for Americans but peace for all men and women--not merely peace in our time but peace for all time." President John F. Kennedy, June 10, 1963_** **You are invited** On October 26, at 2:00 pm, LaRouche independent congressional candidate Jose Vega and I are joining forces at a special event in NYC to bend the trajectory of the western world away from the Armageddon toward which we are currently moving fast, and toward a new paradigm, much more worthy of the dignity of mankind. I keep asking myself, "How can it be, that with the majority of the American people opposed to sending more money to Ukraine to provoke nuclear war with Russia, and also opposing Israel's genocidal onslaught against the Palestinian people, that our so-called 'representatives' feel no obligation to change their policies? Where are these people when Americans are hit by disaster, as in North Carloina or Hawaii?" We must do more! But not as a protest movement! Jose and I are not protesters. We intend to change the policy of the United States. We cannot afford to lose this fight.
## **_Therefore, I am writing to personally tell you, that the most important single thing that you can do this election season, is to be there with us in Manhattan on October 26_**.
Join me and Jose and a number of courageous former military and intelligence leaders, including former UN Weapons Inspector**Scott Ritter** ; Colin Powell's former Chief of staff, **Col. Lawrence Wilkerson** ; former CIA analyst and Veteran Intelligence Professionals for Sanity co-founder **Ray McGovern;** DC-area radio personality **Garland Nixon** , and many others, including Schiller Institute founder **Helga Zepp-LaRouche** (via video livestream). This event will be an indoor rally/concert, with musical selections performed by the Sare/Vega Chorus and soloists as well as brass and string ensembles. I don't think anything like this has been done before, and it is going to have a powerful impact. name: Justice Democrats
subject: Summer Lee’s new bill to raise wages and cut taxes for working-class people
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

The American economy is rigged against working-class
people, Peter.

While the costs of living have skyrocketed, the federal minimum wage has
remained stagnant at $7.25 an hour since 2009, leaving workers with less
money to afford to get by. In the United States, 40 percent of households
can’t afford basic necessities like a roof over their heads, food, and
healthcare.

Income inequality is currently at a 100-year high, with our broken tax
system letting millionaires and billionaires pay less than working
families.

That’s why Justice Democrats Rep. Summer Lee just introduced the American
Stability Act—the largest wage increase and tax cut for working families
in U.S. history. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241004-american-stability-act/?source=em20241004-36046&akid=36046%2E1203867%2Es3JkTS ]Add your name to show your support →

This bill would stop putting billionaires before working people by:

* Immediately increasing the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour, then
increasing it by 10% annually until it reaches $20/hour in 2024
dollars. After that, the stability wage will automatically adjust
every year based on inflation and other factors;

* Creating a Cost-of-Living tax exemption that would prevent basic
living expenses up to the stability wage from being taxed by the
federal government;

* Reforming the tax code so that tax brackets automatically adjust with
wage growth, maintaining fairness over time, while imposing a 3%
surtax on incomes over $1 million and a 5% surtax on incomes over $15
million to ensure the wealthiest few pay their fair share.

This is exactly the kind of bold change we need to unrig our broken system
and achieve economic justice for working families, but it’s going to take
a ton of public pressure to build the Congressional support needed to pass
it into law.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241004-american-stability-act/?source=em20241004-36046&akid=36046%2E1203867%2Es3JkTS ]Will you sign on as a citizen cosponsor of Summer’s bill to finally
create a livable minimum wage and a fair tax system for all across the
country?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241004-american-stability-act/?source=em20241004-36046&akid=36046%2E1203867%2Es3JkTS ]Sign On

In solidarity,

name: Ryan Hamilton
subject: Clark County Is In Dire Need For Help
body:
Clark County is in trouble. Without your help, it might as well become part of California. | | |
---
| | Hi Peter, Clark County deserves better. For too long, the County Commission—made up entirely of entrenched Democratic politicians—has been plagued by corruption, waste, and disregard for the real needs of residents. These career politicians prioritize their own interests over OURS, and the people of Clark County are paying the price.

I am stepping up to save our county from the status quo. I believe in transparency, accountability, and putting residents first. I will fight to end the backroom deals and restore faith in our local government by focusing on what really matters: safer neighborhoods, smarter growth, and a government that serves you—not special interests.

But to break through the current power structure, I NEED your support. Together, we can challenge this corruption and bring real change to Clark County. There is no saving Nevada without saving Clark County.

Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 today to help me fight back against the machine? Every dollar gets us closer to the future we deserve.

Hi Peter,
Last month, the Department of Justice charged two Russian citizens in connection with a $10 million misinformation campaign aimed at sowing division and influencing the 2024 Presidential election.
Unfortunately, even after these criminal indictments, Putin’s attempts to interfere with U.S. elections didn’t stop.
According to _The Washington Post_ , far-right influencers, backed by Russian state media, continued to spread falsehoods to their large audiences. This included debunked claims, such as the bizarre story about Haitians in Springfield, Ohio, eating pets.
**[We’ll explain more shortly, but if you’d like to support COURIER’s efforts to fight the lies and fake news spread by right-wing groups, can you chip in $17 today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94276029/503070367/-593472309?refcode=20241004-EM-RussianMisinfo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmE2MWY5MWQtN2I4Mi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ztw09ISL23U4nRiSX6KpFcgzGMSwWYpqcB6KanmNRKw=)**
In addition to the indictments, the U.S. government seized 32 websites publishing fake news stories—mimicking outlets like _Fox News_ and _The Washington Post_ —in an attempt to disrupt the flow of Russian disinformation. Despite these efforts, Russian bot accounts, now aided by AI, continue to spread “doppelganger” articles on faked versions of established media.
These lies are dangerous:
* Some fake articles insinuated the Secret Service was complicit in assassination attempts against Trump.
* Others spread outright lies about Kamala Harris, alleging she has Alzheimer’s and is pushing puberty blockers due to secret ties to “Big Pharma.”
* A baseless conspiracy about Springfield, Ohio, was amplified by Russian bots, turning a random Facebook post into a viral smear. That lie was then used by Trump and JD Vance to amplify their fear campaign about immigrants.

The Springfield pets lie, and the way Trump and Vance used it, shows just how destructive foreign interference campaigns can be for our elections and communities.
**Right-wing politicians are not afraid to weaponize these lies to spread hate and consolidate power.**
That’s why COURIER exists—to counteract the harmful impact of misinformation in American elections and to strengthen our democracy. We tackle right-wing conspiracy theories and disinformation where they spread the fastest: online, on social media, and in the inboxes of communities most at risk of encountering these falsehoods. This immersive technology allows for a dialogue between you, the candidates, and their expert guests, all from the comfort of your home.

| | | **BREAKING NEWS: Two new polls in Missouri's U.S. Senate race show Lucas Kunce within striking distance of Josh Hawley!**

Your donation will be split between Lucas Kunce and the DSCC to defend the Senate.
Despite Hawley's campaign and billionaire-funded Super PAC spending over $5 MILLION to air false attack ads about Lucas on TV, he's managed to cut Hawley's double-digit lead _in only a matter of weeks._

And that's not the only exciting development in Missouri's U.S. Senate race.

**These polls come after MAJOR news that the initiative to end Missouri's total abortion ban will officially appear on the November ballot.** This is the same kind of abortion initiative that voters in red and purple states have overwhelmingly turned out to vote for since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned in 2022.

Now, Josh Hawley is living his worst nightmare.

[**We need to keep up the pressure -- immediately. Split $5 between Lucas Kunce and the DSCC now to defeat Josh Hawley and defend the Senate!**](https://go.dscc.org/go/20049?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20241004-MissouriPollingUpdate-KuncePollUpdateTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20241004-MissouriPollingUpdate-KuncePollUpdateTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=17941%2E9716520%2E3AV0xL)

**Hawley paved the way for nearly every attack we're seeing on reproductive freedom in our country right now -- including Missouri's total abortion ban.**

Hawley used his taxpayer-funded U.S. Senate office to directly support the suit that overturned _Roe_. He led the case that sought to restrict access to birth control. He pioneered the legal argument that now threatens access to IVF nationwide. And as recently as THIS YEAR, Hawley voted against BOTH the Right to IVF and Right to Contraception Acts in the U.S. Senate.

Have you heard the term _October surprise_ , friend? In campaign speak, an October surprise is what we call a last-minute event that can make or break a close election.
The thing is, you never know what it'll be or who it'll help. **And in a race as close as ours – that will decide Senate control – we need to be prepared for anything and everything.**
_That's why I'm personally asking you to help me kickstart October with your first grassroots donation to my campaign:_

**[Will you chip in $5 or more now to reach my $250,000 goal by midnight so we can put up a firewall to protect this seat and our Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94278570/503077691/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3188-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODFlZjY1ZS03ZjgyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XhUsu7C3HSbzdZUOGKsYpmNr43mePzU4OOpkiikSb70=)**

Hi there,

I’ll never get tired of saying this: thank you! On Monday, my re-election campaign for Congress in CA-25 faced its toughest fundraising challenge yet — our FINAL end of quarter deadline before the November election.

I won’t sugarcoat it — falling short wasn’t an option if we want to ensure our district stays blue this November. Luckily, Team Ruiz isn’t the type to stand down to a challenge.

A show of strength was critical, and that’s exactly what we did.

That’s why I’m so incredibly grateful for you and your support. It’s what carried us to and past our goal — and what’s going to lead us to victory in just 32 days! This isn’t a fight for one, or even two — this is a mass movement to defend the rights we hold dear.

We know all too well that in this day and age, nothing is guaranteed.

From reproductive healthcare to our ability to live in a clean and safe environment, we’ve watched as MAGA extremists in our government have sought to systematically undermine so much of the progress we’ve made in recent years. And so I’ll say it again: nothing is guaranteed.

But there is one thing that we can be sure of: regardless of how far they go, how many of our liberties they strip away — we’re not going anywhere. Because this is more about you and me — this is about securing our collective future.

And it’s through our work — together — that we’ll do just that. If you didn’t get a chance to chip in before the deadline, you can still do so and make just as big of an impact by clicking here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruiz-em-fr-oct24?amount=]

Thank you for standing with me,

Raul

The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. In 2012, he decided to take his service to the community to the next level by running for Congress. Dr. Ruiz needs our help to continue fighting for us in Congress and to flip the House blue this November.

name: Pennsylvania Forward Party
subject: Pennsylvania Forward Party October Newsletter
body:
Going into the 4th quarter

|
#
## ****
## **Pennsylvanians are Voting!**
**This is the opportunity we've been working towards. Help us seize the opportunity, here's how.**
1. **Talk to the people you know**. Sadly, most voters have never heard of us. Your coworkers and family members are probably feeling overwhelmed with presidential ads, they may be relieved to hear that there are people trying to change the binary nature of our politics and that they can help with a vote for Attorney General or State Treasurer.
2. **Highlight social media**. We're attempting to increase our presence between now and the election. Sharing, interreacting, liking the things we post can get our message in front of new people.
3. **Text and Phone bank**. The Forward Party has tools that you can use to support candidates across the country. Sign up to [Volunteer Here](https://home.forwardparty.com/volunteer_2024?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=1). It's fun, easy, and very helpful.
4. **Work the Polls on Election Day**. This is going to be the biggest impact you can have with your time. Voters will be going to the polls who can be convinced to vote for our candidates, someone just has to ask them to. Please pledge to work the polls by replying to this email or request materials with [this link](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Cau9QZYSrELuaBTd-UPVTqHj5ypwcVC4lINLBKQ1dRWcq0jNIi1AnxdAILAhhSmx&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=2).

### **Canvassing Opportunities in Philadelphia**
During our signature collecting campaign this summer, our wonderful volunteer, Nancy Hanks, organized weekly opportunities at Rittenhouse Square in Center City Philadelphia and now she's at it again. Every Saturday between now and the election you can find Nancy and a rotating group of volunteers getting the word out about Forward and our tremendous candidates. Forward candidate Eric Settle has even been known to join and meet voters himself. On 10/26, we also are expecting to be joined by Forward Co-Chair, Governor Christine Todd Whitman. To Join Nancy, feel free to reach out to her directly at [hanksnan@gmail.com](mailto:hanksnan@gmail.com) or just come to the corner of 18th and Walnut from 9:30am to 12:30pm any of the next 5 Saturdays. If you don't live near Nancy, you should feel free to duplicate her effort in your town. Please reach out to us with tabling opportunities and we'll help you set up an event. Join us October 21st at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call to talk about how we support our candidates of the next few months and why it's so important. Please RSVP below. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u5bGNJ8O5s1t4PZDN8Q8c88Dkr-3BASjG94O7_LKgOEUEIRPxJ5xS97cPyDSOIesMA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=3) There will also be an Eric Settle campaign call the week before led by campaign manager Rafe Damico. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u9pL5MpT6VqtFQJKvKaK-PuXeP9Jm2m6Enk9qVv_xOmp-62jC2_ixhs7zeq-wFW9mw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=4) [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=k1wEMZKawatLobqqoHU4rL-DZ6X72BSvaB6jjTZIDhZQg1H4k18eAnazPXzY27IYq4Nkfcdl077KlnGnlTr3TA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=5) [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=k1wEMZKawatLobqqoHU4rL-DZ6X72BSvaB6jjTZIDhbij3QVwY9eUQwAsvUJGG4gc7p0anSk8XoeKank4c4Pig&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=6)
## Forward Candidates Featured on PCN
Check out their interviews below if you missed them. [Chris Foster 9/27](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfYK7NZaaEbP1bsdDy18Gpjb&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=7) [Eric Settle 10/3](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfal_embnlCsDtQsre4Bntjr&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=8) **Click below to read the articles******[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfabOCJ4ZZ5huiiWdTZc84Iy&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_oct_newsletter&n=9)

clean_body: Going into the 4th quarter | ** Pennsylvanians are Voting! This is the opportunity we've been working towards. Help us seize the opportunity, here's how. 1. Talk to the people you know. Sadly, most voters have never heard of us. Your coworkers and family members are probably feeling overwhelmed with presidential ads, they may be relieved to hear that there are people trying to change the binary nature of our politics and that they can help with a vote for Attorney General or State Treasurer. 2. Highlight social media. We're attempting to increase our presence between now and the election. Sharing, interreacting, liking the things we post can get our message in front of new people. 3. Text and Phone bank. The Forward Party has tools that you can use to support candidates across the country. Sign up to . It's fun, easy, and very helpful. 4. Work the Polls on Election Day. This is going to be the biggest impact you can have with your time. Voters will be going to the polls who can be convinced to vote for our candidates, someone just has to ask them to. Please pledge to work the polls by replying to this email or request materials with . Canvassing Opportunities in Philadelphia During our signature collecting campaign this summer, our wonderful volunteer, Nancy Hanks, organized weekly opportunities at Rittenhouse Square in Center City Philadelphia and now she's at it again. Every Saturday between now and the election you can find Nancy and a rotating group of volunteers getting the word out about Forward and our tremendous candidates. Forward candidate Eric Settle has even been known to join and meet voters himself. On 10/26, we also are expecting to be joined by Forward Co-Chair, Governor Christine Todd Whitman. To Join Nancy, feel free to reach out to her directly at mailto:hanksnan@gmail.com or just come to the corner of 18th and Walnut from 9:30am to 12:30pm any of the next 5 Saturdays. If you don't live near Nancy, you should feel free to duplicate her effort in your town. Please reach out to us with tabling opportunities and we'll help you set up an event. Join us October 21st at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call to talk about how we support our candidates of the next few months and why it's so important. Please RSVP below. There will also be an Eric Settle campaign call the week before led by campaign manager Rafe Damico. Forward Candidates Featured on PCN Check out their interviews below if you missed them. My name is George Logan:
* I am a first-generation African American and Black Hispanic Republican.

* I earned my bachelor's degree in engineering from Trinity College and my master's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Bridgeport.

* I served two terms in the Connecticut State Senate.

* I'm the frontman for a Jimi Hendrix tribute band and volunteer my free time at the YMCA as a youth mentor.

As an engineer and community leader, I have spent my life solving problems, both big and small.

Being a first-generation Afro-Latino American, many assume I must be a Democrat - but that couldn't be further from the truth. I am a proud Afro-Latino Republican, ready to fight against radical politicians and work towards rebuilding the America we love.

_**[But I need your help, Peter.](https://trk.emails.georgeloganforcongress.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6ODUwMTYxMzYsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMjU5MC1kcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0Mjc4LTdhYWZlZmQ2NGQ4YTQyMDJhYTU1YmZlMTJiYThhNDI4IiwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMiIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vc2VjdXJlLndpbnJlZC5jb20vZ2VvcmdlLWxvZ2FuLWZvci1jb25ncmVzcy9teS1zdG9yeS8_bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTI5JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI0MTAwNF9TSS1NSC4xMTAxMTdfdDE1NTY0NDUtMjU5MCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNDEwMDRfU0ktTUguMTEwMTE3X3QxNTU2NDQ1LTI1OTAifQ/qFf7em-l7EGWYavnlXIJPg "But I need your help, %%First_Name__c%%.")**_

In 2022, I came within less than 1% of flipping this seat from Squad member Jahana Hayes. Despite facing relentless and often racist attacks, I did not give up. I am a problem solver, and when there's no solution, I build one.

This campaign is our solution to end the Democrat chaos and one-party politics that have left our communities struggling.

We are at a critical crossroads. The choices we make now will determine the future of our nation. We cannot afford to get this one wrong! **This could be our LAST CHANCE to set America back on the right track.**

Allow me to reintroduce myself and share why "I am the Republican candidate poised to flip one of the Squad’s stronghold districts in just 45 DAYS!" My name is George Logan: I am a first-generation African American and Black Hispanic Republican. I earned my bachelor's degree in engineering from Trinity College and my master's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Bridgeport. I served two terms in the Connecticut State Senate. I'm the frontman for a Jimi Hendrix tribute band and volunteer my free time at the YMCA as a youth mentor. As an engineer and community leader, I have spent my life solving problems, both big and small. Being a first-generation Afro-Latino American, many assume I must be a Democrat - but that couldn't be further from the truth. I am a proud Afro-Latino Republican, ready to fight against radical politicians and work towards rebuilding the America we love. "But I need your help, %%FirstNamec%%." In 2022, I came within less than 1% of flipping this seat from Squad member Jahana Hayes. Despite facing relentless and often racist attacks, I did not give up. I am a problem solver, and when there's no solution, I build one. This campaign is our solution to end the Democrat chaos and one-party politics that have left our communities struggling. We are at a critical crossroads. The choices we make now will determine the future of our nation. We cannot afford to get this one wrong! **" 'Strive for excellence': How a $70M restoration will return the UT Tower to its former glory,"** Austin American-Statesman's**Lily Kepner** -- "On the west clockface of the University of Texas Tower ― a treasured Longhorn landmark that was once the city's tallest building ― a cricket rests on the hand. Individual light bulbs create the clock face's glow, and mechanical technology that clicks every 30 seconds powers the hand forward.

The tower opened in 1937 to be the university's main building and library. Decorated with seals of the world's greatest universities and names of the Western world's renowned thinkers, the tower represents the tireless ambition that has propelled UT forward for a century. Steel bookshelves literally reinforce the building's structure, and the institution has still not reached the building's massive capacity for books.

View the iconic landmark from Interstate 35 or U.S. 290, the gold paint chipping off the clocks' edges, the bumpy observation desk, and the burnt-orange rust on the building's side and windows, can't be seen. But to passersby on the Forty Acres, the aged features can obscure the tower's most notable design elements and the excellence it represents to alums, students and UT leaders.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/a080c8c0-113d-469d-9407-9a042c520adc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now, after 87 years, university administrators have committed to undertaking the largest reinvestment in the landmark since it was built.

Starting in November, the tower will undergo a $70 million, multi-year restoration. The goal is for project to finish by August 2027, restoring the building to its "former glory," President **Jay Hartzell** said.
The scope of the project, [initially added to the Capital Improvement Plan](https://substack.com/redirect/f69d1609-64d1-48b4-a9a9-2d789faf263f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by University of Texas System regents in February, has narrowed to only focus on the building's exterior due to higher-than-anticipated costs. Renovations to the building itself are expected to cost $56,385,000 -- about $10 million more than the expected cost. The initially planned interior renovations and grounds restoration to improve visitors' experience will be deferred until other funds are identified, Hartzell said, due to the intricate level of work required and associated expenses.

Regents in August approved the newly narrowed scope and officially authorized the previously agreed-upon $70 million for the project: $26 million from donations, $26 million from the Permanent University Fund Bond, and $18 million from the Available University Fund.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/a080c8c0-113d-469d-9407-9a042c520adc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In an exclusive interview with the American-Statesman, Hartzell said the restoration will set the UT Tower up for long-term success. He described the iconic landmark as both a unifying symbol and "a beacon for what we want the university to be."

"When you think about the boldness of a pretty young university in a pretty small town deciding to build a building taller than the state Capitol, to be a library that was going to hold more books than we owned, it was a sign in that time of audacity, ambition, strive for excellence," Hartzell said. "The tower still has that same connotation to us -- what is possible for a world class university."

Today, the tower is the awaited backdrop for student graduation photos, a symbol that glows orange in moments of university celebration, the home of the familiar sounding Carillon's bells and the president's office. The renovation was regents-initiated, Chairman **Kevin Eltife** said, and he thanked Hartzell for his vision and the university for raising funds.

The renovation will regild and paint the clocks, clean and restore of the exterior of the building to its original form, gild key decorative elements, clean masonry, replace the lighting (now often done manually) with LED lights, and waterproof the tower observation deck and the room with the instrument that controls the tower's 52 carillon bells." ($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS " 'Strive for excellence': How a $70M restoration will return the UT Tower to its former glory," Austin American-Statesman'sLily Kepner -- "On the west clockface of the University of Texas Tower ― a treasured Longhorn landmark that was once the city's tallest building ― a cricket rests on the hand. Individual light bulbs create the clock face's glow, and mechanical technology that clicks every 30 seconds powers the hand forward. The tower opened in 1937 to be the university's main building and library. Decorated with seals of the world's greatest universities and names of the Western world's renowned thinkers, the tower represents the tireless ambition that has propelled UT forward for a century. Steel bookshelves literally reinforce the building's structure, and the institution has still not reached the building's massive capacity for books. View the iconic landmark from Interstate 35 or U.S. 290, the gold paint chipping off the clocks' edges, the bumpy observation desk, and the burnt-orange rust on the building's side and windows, can't be seen. But to passersby on the Forty Acres, the aged features can obscure the tower's most notable design elements and the excellence it represents to alums, students and UT leaders. Now, after 87 years, university administrators have committed to undertaking the largest reinvestment in the landmark since it was built. Starting in November, the tower will undergo a $70 million, multi-year restoration. The goal is for project to finish by August 2027, restoring the building to its "former glory," President Jay Hartzell said. The scope of the project, by University of Texas System regents in February, has narrowed to only focus on the building's exterior due to higher-than-anticipated costs. Renovations to the building itself are expected to cost $56,385,000 -- about $10 million more than the expected cost. The initially planned interior renovations and grounds restoration to improve visitors' experience will be deferred until other funds are identified, Hartzell said, due to the intricate level of work required and associated expenses. Regents in August approved the newly narrowed scope and officially authorized the previously agreed-upon $70 million for the project: $26 million from donations, $26 million from the Permanent University Fund Bond, and $18 million from the Available University Fund. In an exclusive interview with the American-Statesman, Hartzell said the restoration will set the UT Tower up for long-term success. He described the iconic landmark as both a unifying symbol and "a beacon for what we want the university to be." "When you think about the boldness of a pretty young university in a pretty small town deciding to build a building taller than the state Capitol, to be a library that was going to hold more books than we owned, it was a sign in that time of audacity, ambition, strive for excellence," Hartzell said. "The tower still has that same connotation to us -- what is possible for a world class university." Today, the tower is the awaited backdrop for student graduation photos, a symbol that glows orange in moments of university celebration, the home of the familiar sounding Carillon's bells and the president's office. The renovation was regents-initiated, Chairman Kevin Eltife said, and he thanked Hartzell for his vision and the university for raising funds. The renovation will regild and paint the clocks, clean and restore of the exterior of the building to its original form, gild key decorative elements, clean masonry, replace the lighting (now often done manually) with LED lights, and waterproof the tower observation deck and the room with the instrument that controls the tower's 52 carillon bells." * **TOP NEWS**

**" 'Strive for excellence': How a $70M restoration will return the UT Tower to its former glory,"** Austin American-Statesman's**Lily Kepner** -- "On the west clockface of the University of Texas Tower ― a treasured Longhorn landmark that was once the city's tallest building ― a cricket rests on the hand. Individual light bulbs create the clock face's glow, and mechanical technology that clicks every 30 seconds powers the hand forward.

The tower opened in 1937 to be the university's main building and library. Decorated with seals of the world's greatest universities and names of the Western world's renowned thinkers, the tower represents the tireless ambition that has propelled UT forward for a century. Steel bookshelves literally reinforce the building's structure, and the institution has still not reached the building's massive capacity for books.

View the iconic landmark from Interstate 35 or U.S. 290, the gold paint chipping off the clocks' edges, the bumpy observation desk, and the burnt-orange rust on the building's side and windows, can't be seen. But to passersby on the Forty Acres, the aged features can obscure the tower's most notable design elements and the excellence it represents to alums, students and UT leaders.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/6e85aa65-0ae4-464e-91ad-3f15677772dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now, after 87 years, university administrators have committed to undertaking the largest reinvestment in the landmark since it was built.

Starting in November, the tower will undergo a $70 million, multi-year restoration. The goal is for project to finish by August 2027, restoring the building to its "former glory," President **Jay Hartzell** said.
The scope of the project, [initially added to the Capital Improvement Plan](https://substack.com/redirect/5e1b54d5-ec4c-4e87-bdb6-d78df7f38739?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by University of Texas System regents in February, has narrowed to only focus on the building's exterior due to higher-than-anticipated costs. Renovations to the building itself are expected to cost $56,385,000 -- about $10 million more than the expected cost. The initially planned interior renovations and grounds restoration to improve visitors' experience will be deferred until other funds are identified, Hartzell said, due to the intricate level of work required and associated expenses.

Regents in August approved the newly narrowed scope and officially authorized the previously agreed-upon $70 million for the project: $26 million from donations, $26 million from the Permanent University Fund Bond, and $18 million from the Available University Fund.

The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

I’ve dedicated my life to telling America’s stories through film. They examine moments of our country in crisis and threats to our democracy. And more often than not, those stories aren’t easy ones to tell. With that in mind, it’s not difficult for me to assess that our country is at a crossroads right now, and this is the most consequential election of our lives. I’m not exaggerating when I say the stakes have never been higher: _the fate of our one-seat Democratic Senate majority — and all the progress that comes with it — lies with Wisconsin and Tammy Baldwin’s reelection._ **This is a challenge we _must_ meet.** As history shows, this race will come down to the smallest percentage of votes. And Republicans have already poured tens of millions of dollars into Tammy’s opponent in an effort to flip Wisconsin’s Senate seat and take back the Senate majority. Reproductive freedom, access to affordable health care, and our very democracy is at stake. With so much on the line, we cannot afford to lose this seat and Tammy’s leadership in the Senate. clean_body: When will enough finally be enough? | One year ago today, the GOP ousted Kevin McCarthy as their Speaker, Peter. Since they’ve had the majority, it’s been nothing but chaos and dysfunction year-round. They've taken us to the brink of a government shutdown (more than once), tanked their own bills because they can’t agree on anything, and dropped their leadership the moment they had a chance to start working for the people instead of their party. The GOP’s constant infighting and gridlock have made it impossible for Congress to get anything done for hard working Americans. We can’t keep going on like this. It’s been one mess after another, and the American people are the ones paying the price. Peter, make no mistake: National Republicans know that Matt's opponent will fall right in line with this broken system. That’s why they’re doing everything they can to prop him up and to try and flip our district red.What we need now more than ever is leadership that will put people over politics, work to bring real solutions to the table, and get our government running the way it should. That’s what Matt is fighting for every day in Congress – but he can’t do it alone. This race is going to be tough, and we're counting on this grassroots team to stand with Matt in these final weeks before Election Day. Wisconsin is on the frontlines in our fight for our reproductive rights. We have their back.
#
If Donald Trump wins in November, you better believe that he and a Republican Congress will enact a national abortion ban in all 50 states that would topple any and all state laws.
That alone is one enormous reason why it is crucial that we elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House this November.
And that’s why we visited Wisconsin last weekend — where there was a near-total abortion ban for 451 days after Roe v. Wade was overturned by the most corrupt Supreme Court in our history — to say loud and clear: **reproductive freedom is an inalienable right for all people**. Hi Peter,
In many ways, Arizona is ground zero for climate change.
As weather patterns become more extreme, we face extreme heat, wildfires, loss of biodiversity, and drought.
Kirsten has spent her career working to address climate change and protect Arizona’s water security. When she was in the state legislature, she worked across the aisle to create a plan to protect our water future. She understands this issue inside and out — and in Congress, she will fight to ensure every Southwest Basin state has access to a fair amount of water long into the future.
Kirsten’s opponent, Juan Ciscomani, has taken a different approach.
He was part of the Doug Ducey administration when they cut a deal to sell billions of gallons of our water to Saudi farms. And since he ran for office, he’s accepted huge checks from the lobbyists who pushed for the deal.
Kirsten has fought to protect Arizona’s future. Ciscomani has done the exact opposite.
Ciscomani is counting on corporate super PACs and lobbyists to help him win this toss-up race. Will you help our grassroots campaign fight back by chipping in now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_100424_Water_act]

Friends,
We are officially in the final stretch— early voting in Ohio starts in just three days .
That means we’re down to the wire, and every dollar we raise right now will fuel the big push to get our message in front of voters and get them to the polls.
Here’s the deal: our polling shows that the more people learn about Jim Jordan’s disastrous record, the more they’re ready to vote him OUT .
We’ve seen it happen—once Ohioans know Jordan has spent 17 years doing nothing but blocking progress, they choose us.
But we need to reach as many voters as possible in these next few days, and that’s where you come in.
Can you contribute right now to help us ensure every voter knows the truth about Jim Jordan before early voting starts? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241004_3days_to_early_voting_link1]
Early voting can make or break an election .
If we run up the score now, we can overwhelm Jordan on Election Day and send him packing for good.
But to make it happen, we MUST put everything we have into these last 3 days.
This is our moment to reach undecided voters, get them to the polls, and make sure Jordan’s lies don’t go unanswered.
We’re talking about his lies on voter fraud that fueled the insurrection on January 6th, his denial of basic climate science as our communities suffer, and his reckless falsehoods about the safety of vaccines that put public health at risk.
Jordan has spread dangerous misinformation for years, all to serve his political ambitions and protect his extremist allies.
Now is the time to hold him accountable.
We’ve got the momentum on our side, and with your help, we can seal the deal.
If we can get our ads, canvassers, and voter outreach teams in front of as many people as possible in these next 96 hours, we’ll set ourselves up for a massive early voting turnout that could change the course of this race.
This is the most important congressional race in the country, and what we do right now could be the difference between victory and defeat.
Please dig deep today to help us deliver our message to every last voter before early voting begins. Let’s make sure Jim Jordan knows his time is up. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241004_3days_to_early_voting_link2]

| | _**Mike Braun Wins Back to Back Debates!**_
---
Friends, It’s an exciting time for Indiana! Over the past two nights, Mike Braun has shown he is the leader Hoosiers can count on. His message is clear: he’s focused on the kitchen table issues that matter most—fighting inflation, lowering healthcare costs, and improving education. Mike Braun’s Freedom and Opportunity vision is to strengthen families, reduce taxes, and make every dollar count.

In contrast, Democrat Jennifer McCormick continues to push for liberal policies that are out of step with Hoosier values. Her support for bigger government and higher taxes would create more bureaucracy and strain on hardworking families. McCormick’s embrace of expensive, far-left ideas—backed by national Democrats—would put our state’s financial future at risk. She has stood behind the reckless spending that fueled inflation and would welcome costly programs that Hoosiers simply cannot afford. Her vision for Indiana would lead to more government control and fewer opportunities for everyday Hoosiers.

However, the Democrat Governors Association (DGA) recently poured $600,000 into McCormick’s campaign to try to keep her afloat and flip Indiana blue. We cannot take anything for granted. Now more than ever, we need everyone to stay engaged, energized, and committed to ensuring Republican victories up and down the ballot.

This is a critical moment for Indiana, and together, we will secure a brighter, stronger future with Mike Braun leading the way. Thank you all for what you do!

_**Mike Braun’s Plan to Fight Inflation & Improve the Economy!**_
---
---
Below are highlights from the Freedom and Opportunity Agenda - Plan to Improve the economy and combat inflation.
---
**1) Historic Tax Relief**
* Inflation has caused home values to skyrocket while, at the same time, wages have remained stagnant. As a result, Hoosiers are paying more of their paycheck to property tax bills, putting too many homeowners at risk of losing their homes

* **Mike Braun's plan will** Allow Hoosiers access to more of their paychecks as they contend with Bidenflation’s impact on their ability to afford everyday life.

**2) Good Paying Jobs**
* As the State takes steps to foster a resilient and diversified economy, and position itself at the forefront of next-generation industries, support for a robust workforce will be critical.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** Combat wage stagnation by concentrating on the creation of good-paying jobs and incentivizing employers to raise wages.

**3) Affordable and Reliable Energy**
* Over the last decade, Hoosiers’ electricity bills have increased dramatically, outpacing the national average. At the same time, Indiana’s power grid operators have warned ratepayers about the threat of rolling brownouts during extreme heat and cold.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** Embrace an energy policy that unleashes the prosperity of our state’s abundant natural resources and delivers new technologies that provide clean and affordable energy.

**4) Streamlined Regulations and Government Services**
* Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, but they often face unnecessary regulatory hurdles that stifle growth and innovation.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** Protect small businesses facing unnecessary and costly regulations and create an environment for small businesses to thrive.

**5) Leaner, Efficient State Government**
* Unlike the private sector, where real economics incentivize efficiency and lower overhead, government at every level has grown unchecked.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** Institute private sector principles across state government to ensure Hoosiers are getting the services they need with greater efficiency and effectiveness.

---
**Mike Braun issued the following statement upon releasing his plan to fight inflation:** _**“Traveling Indiana I hear from so many Hoosiers who feel like they’re barely keeping their head above water due to Bidenflation, rising utility bills, high property taxes, and wages that just aren’t keeping up. My plan is directed at Hoosier families sitting around the kitchen table trying to make ends meet: My top priority is to make things better for you.” – Mike Braun**_

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=98cbc476ad2643368fbf3572e99c93c2&_e=zcS924W9u0hndlnyQKixgKCQT8SmFcvblMQ5b65N-GYxNGv75NHrymPJbhQdwN-nokdX7OSW1O4yH_M10_sIk20bkpWzfZ_8z-kAcRgdpAfkfYHDS531QRDXWAwhT475wUqoG1YWXbTUMVbERptsqCu8Kc-fOAKl_Sm5BMc8yNwMyILYoJedoipvQHi6jpcYGG-ShodtCQ-9y5sfwqNPEdZ4ZpN1zMWKN0wtu9mMqb0hs-3WXjnk2cr-JZ-rjZhTBjHLz0m9M9v5FkjiwsX4QYRksNNc3-yOXmO55MO2QiSaqmmETYJrwjG1QxD6Xo4KfYL80lF50e_PxCJA5zj7hKXYpw0eZer5BWz30pkhanl3vrrQRLCAzfVxyVbSzmxweauo4fOGdkJZcAiqKGeNgKHRgoGYHJjj1NZzJY1iOy1HFPDvD79Sbkw4gnlSXxH9) [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=98cbc476ad2643368fbf3572e99c93c2&_e=zcS924W9u0hndlnyQKixgKCQT8SmFcvblMQ5b65N-GYxNGv75NHrymPJbhQdwN-nokdX7OSW1O4yH_M10_sIk20bkpWzfZ_8z-kAcRgdpAfkfYHDS531QRDXWAwhT475wUqoG1YWXbTUMVbERptsqCu8Kc-fOAKl_Sm5BMc8yNwMyILYoJedoipvQHi6jpcYGG-ShodtCQ-9y5sfwqNPEdZ4ZpN1zMWKN0wtu9mMqb0hs-3WXjnk2cr-JZ-rjZhTBjHLz0m9M9v5FkjiwsX4QcEaeOyc71drMVpKbNOGByc-jXJZclKD4CL2PHH1S4G80wWtiOorIwKP4AxH9nfNJYneqi-dG4CrwuzUWAMN8-2wTPyj_oYfJRIiwH1Tcl_ARNHEdLqwB_6mUdKy0JORrqgq_tWnyI4B6NBpcbTng5IILM8C_S2pf3rd8q1kjmBa) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=98cbc476ad2643368fbf3572e99c93c2&_e=zcS924W9u0hndlnyQKixgKCQT8SmFcvblMQ5b65N-GYxNGv75NHrymPJbhQdwN-nokdX7OSW1O4yH_M10_sIk20bkpWzfZ_8z-kAcRgdpAfkfYHDS531QRDXWAwhT475wUqoG1YWXbTUMVbERptsqCu8Kc-fOAKl_Sm5BMc8yNwMyILYoJedoipvQHi6jpcYGG-ShodtCQ-9y5sfwqNPEdZ4ZpN1zMWKN0wtu9mMqb0hs-3WXjnk2cr-JZ-rjZhTBjHLz0m9M9v5FkjiwsX4QaQKJTLG0WTtjuTUFYTVaK8FS2RMwAMuBACnd5jbdOiJdVYJNsJlg66B9AiP4vpSaJOppoZEOsnqczLy9s_2w57ogmfE0LrIXW9kpQDV4bfvmFpod0GZLo1wiAhJTNhwjK-E_v13gFTW5FTTEqrjsWSPh8kyzLN90GCJXPMDbClo)

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

My opponent, radical leftist Sherrod Brown, ought to be ashamed of himself. He’s turned his back on Americans in need.

_I will NEVER do that, fellow patriot._

body:
_* Sent in support of Tammy Baldwin for Wisconsin and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
Hi Peter — If it’s anything like mine, I can only assume your inbox is full of requests from campaigns like mine trying to earn your support.
And I’m guessing you didn’t wake up today thinking, _“today’s the day I’m going to donate to Tammy’s reelection campaign!”_ But I hope you’ll give me a chance to make the case.
**Republicans have engaged in an all out ad blitz to flip my seat red.** Eric Hovde and the dark money super PACs supporting him have poured tens of millions of dollars into this race to defeat me.
If they flip Wisconsin red, they’ll take back our Senate majority. And then, a national abortion ban, cuts to Social Security and Medicare, a repeal of the Affordable Care Act, and so much more will be on the table.
Wisconsin is shaping up to be THE tipping point state that will decide control of the Senate, and our race has quickly become one of the most expensive and competitive in the country.
As poll after poll shows a statistically tied race, it’s urgent that we fight back against the Republican attacks I’m facing with ads of our own to set the record straight.
But these ad reservations don’t come cheap, and I don’t have the same luxury of dipping into a personal fortune to fund this campaign like my megamillionaire opponent can. That’s why I’m counting on your grassroots support today.
**If you are ready to make a difference and help us defend our Democratic Senate majority, now’s the time, Peter.**
**[Can I count on you to split a donation between Lucas Kunce and my reelection campaign? Your donation today will go directly towards helping us defend Wisconsin’s Senate seat and our Democratic Senate majority.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75040?refcode=em20241004-7923&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7923%2E614464%2EaWZDH0)**

If they flip Wisconsin red, they’ll take back our Senate majority. And then, a national abortion ban, cuts to Social Security and Medicare, a repeal of the Affordable Care Act, and so much more will be on the table. Wisconsin is shaping up to be THE tipping point state that will decide control of the Senate, and our race has quickly become one of the most expensive and competitive in the country.
