## "I'm Mary Peltola and I approved this message."

Dear Friends,

**Those were the first words uttered in the most dishonest and outright false advertisements in recent Alaskan memory. **

I hope you’re as fired up as I am because we’ve got a mud fight on our hands. Mary Peltola and her hard-left DC backers are willing to do anything to keep their stranglehold on Alaska.

**My opponent, Mary Peltola, and her dark-money friends have launched the most dishonest smears in Alaskan political history.** You've probably seen the ads -- they are spending millions of dollars on them. And they want to make me seem as scary as they possibly can.

But it's not really me that they are scared of -- __they are scared of**you**__.

**They're scared of you because we are unified. Common-sense Alaskans are united as never before -- and Nancy Pelosi, Hakeem Jeffries, and the rest of the hard-left DC elite know that spells disaster for their agenda, and for their favorite ally, Mary Peltola.**

Here's the truth: the ads you're seeing are full of outright fabrications. And what's worse? **Mary Peltola knows it.** She's approved this disgraceful attempt to mislead Alaskans.

**I’m not backing down, but I need your help to push back.**

**We can’t let these dishonest attacks go unanswered.** Campaigns are expensive, and right now, we need the resources to set the record straight.

**I need your help,_today_. **

Will you help us [push back](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=a6a9bfbd52&e=6679001ba0) against these outrageous smears with a [contribution of $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can afford](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=e5c50b174f&e=6679001ba0)?

The stakes are high, and time is short. Together, we can show the socialist left that their lies have no place in Alaskan politics.

Let's take our nation back from the radicals!

Thank you for standing with me.

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress

So with just 32 days to go in this election, I have a request for you. We are in the fourth quarter of this campaign. Our job is to get in the trenches and do the blocking and tackling. One inch at a time. One yard at a time. One phone call at a time. One door knock at a time.** ******** | | | Look, we've got just 32 days left. That's nothing. We're going to leave it all on the field. That's how we'll keep moving forward. That's how we'll turn the page on Donald Trump. That's how we'll build a country where workers come first, health care and housing are human rights, and our personal freedoms are guaranteed. But it’s going to take all of us talking to our neighbors about what’s at stake and making sure folks have a plan to cast their ballots before polls close on November 5. **** Thank you for all you do for this campaign. Together, we will chart a new way forward for our country. I’m grateful, Tim Tim Walz Governor, Minnesota | | | |

That’s why I want to be clear: I will always protect a woman’s right to an abortion. I will defend reproductive freedom. | Peter- This week, I highlighted the failures at our southern border created by Border Czar Kamala Harris (yes, she was the Border Czar no matter what the media says otherwise) in light of her ridiculous trip to the U.S.-Mexico Border. I also discussed the proper response from Israel in the aftermath of another missile barrage on Israeli territory by Iran. **Thank you to everyone who responded with a contribution to my message last week. We are hurtling toward November 5th, the most important election of our lifetimes. Do not lose sight of control of the House of Representatives in this election. While all the focus is on the presidential election, Republicans must maintain control of the House regardless of what happens at the top of the ticket. I’m going to be spending my time, energy, and resources helping Republicans in tough seats win re-election and help flip Democrat-held swing seats. When you donate to my campaign, that’s the mission you're helping. If you’re able to contribute, I would greatly appreciate it and you can do so here: **
---
| | | | | [ DONATE NOW ](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J9CKRADYB3RFVWPH0DR9FW42_1)
---
| As always, thank you for your continued support. Now here’s your brief.
---
|
---
| THE ARSONIST VISITS THE BURNED DOWN HOUSE
---
| |
---
| Out of all of Kamala Harris’s shameless attempts to rebrand herself, her messaging on border security is beyond the pale.
When Kamala Harris was running for president the last time, she promised to decriminalize illegal border crossings. She promised free health care for illegal immigrants. She supported dismantling ICE and “starting from scratch.”
As San Francisco’s DA, she boasted about being a “sanctuary city,” supporting policies that let criminals avoid ICE detainers. As a Senator, she pushed to strip $220M from ICE’s Enforcement and Removal Operations—the unit responsible for deporting dangerous criminals. And as Border Czar, her policies created the chaos we see today.
This is who Kamala Harris is.
No half-baked last minute day trip to the border can change her 20 year history of supporting open borders and opposing enforcement of our immigration laws.
And if you have any questions as to whether Kamala Harris was actually the Border Czar, [watch this helpful video](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J9CKRADYB3RFVWPH0DR9FW42_2) for a reminder that she is only ditching the title now that it is politically inconvenient for her.
---
|

---
| | [ SIGN UP HERE TO ATTEND ](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J9CKRADYB3RFVWPH0DR9FW42_4)
---
|
---
| ILLEGAL IMMIGRATION CRISIS AT OUR OTHER BORDER
---
| |
---
| [**CLICK HERE TO WATCH**](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J9CKRADYB3RFVWPH0DR9FW42_5)
---
| You have to watch this video to understand the magnitude of the Biden-Harris Administration’s failures on illegal immigration. We are effectively being squeezed by an illegal immigration crisis as a country, with both our northern and southern borders effectively wide open under this administration.
It’s not just the southern border that Harris screwed up. 19,000 illegal immigrants were apprehended last year at a SINGLE sector on the northern border. That’s higher than the previous 17 fiscal years - combined.
Why did it get so much worse this past year? Because Joe and Kamala left a glaring loophole in their executive order to ‘crack down’ on illegal immigration.
It’s almost like...wait for it...incentives matter and criminals will break laws if you let them. Joe Biden doesn’t understand these incentives as president, and neither will Kamala Harris. The crisis will only get worse with her in the Oval Office.
---
|
---
| ISRAEL MUST DEFEND ITSELF
---
| |
---
| [**CLICK HERE TO WATCH**](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J9CKRADYB3RFVWPH0DR9FW42_6)
---
| As Israel systematically dismantles Iranian proxies in the Middle East, Iran is lashing out in an increasingly erratic manner. This week, Iran launched a barrage of ballistic missiles on Israel in an escalatory attack. Thankfully, the missiles did little damage to Israel or Israeli citizens. But we cannot allow Iran to continue this aggression against our ally, and Israel cannot wait for another Iranian escalation. They must hit back hard and decisively.
Iran’s reckless aggression has sealed its fate. Now, Israel has the momentum, and they’re not going to let it slip away. When you’re dealing with a threat like this, you don’t let your enemy rebuild—you keep the pressure on.
Equally important, the United States must give Israel the latitude and support Israel needs to deter further aggression from Iran. Only Israel can decide the time, place, and manner of their counter attack, but they should seize the initiative against an increasingly weak Iran.
The Biden-Harris Administration is unfortunately but unsurprisingly showing weakness at precisely the wrong time elsewhere in the region, [vacating U.S. presence from longstanding bases in Iraq](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J9CKRADYB3RFVWPH0DR9FW42_7) in a misguided deal with the Iraqi government.
This sends the wrong message at the worst possible time—just when Iran's regional proxy terror network is collapsing. Their leadership is in disarray, and their capabilities are crumbling. Now Biden-Harris want to give them some breathing room by handing over Iraq to Iran.
In the Middle East, strength is respected, and any sign of weakness is exploited. This deal will be seen as a display of weakness because it gives the Iranians exactly what they’ve wanted since 2003: less American influence in Iraq, giving them the opportunity to make Iraq a fully-fledged proxy state.
Pulling back now would be a catastrophic mistake—a repeat of the Afghanistan debacle. It would be the unnecessary concession of hard fought gains, protected by a relatively small and cheap US footprint. And what would we gain from the deal? Nothing. Absolutely nothing. Let’s not make the same mistake again.

When you’re dealing with a threat like this, you don’t let your enemy rebuild—you keep the pressure on. Equally important, the United States must give Israel the latitude and support Israel needs to deter further aggression from Iran. Only Israel can decide the time, place, and manner of their counter attack, but they should seize the initiative against an increasingly weak Iran. The Biden-Harris Administration is unfortunately but unsurprisingly showing weakness at precisely the wrong time elsewhere in the region, in a misguided deal with the Iraqi government. This sends the wrong message at the worst possible time—just when Iran's regional proxy terror network is collapsing. Their leadership is in disarray, and their capabilities are crumbling. Now Biden-Harris want to give them some breathing room by handing over Iraq to Iran. In the Middle East, strength is respected, and any sign of weakness is exploited. This deal will be seen as a display of weakness because it gives the Iranians exactly what they’ve wanted since 2003: less American influence in Iraq, giving them the opportunity to make Iraq a fully-fledged proxy state. Pulling back now would be a catastrophic mistake—a repeat of the Afghanistan debacle. It would be the unnecessary concession of hard fought gains, protected by a relatively small and cheap US footprint. And what would we gain from the deal? Nothing. Absolutely nothing. I have weighed in on the value of national polls in the past and how the national media likes to discuss them despite the fact we vote by state not nationally. In an effort to distract from how well Trump is doing in the battleground states and his pursuit of 270 electoral votes, the media wants you to focus on national polls that don't matter.
Beyond the polls though there is more and more actual data that we should be paying attention to down the home stretch. Every Wednesday we are updating the Road to 270 (and you saw above we have a special LIVE episode coming up on Oct 13th) and incorporating this data.

Hi, Brian King here. **It's official: tomorrow we cross the threshold and head into the final 30 days of this election.** Out-fundraising Gov. Cox during an important deadline, speaking to Utahns throughout the state and earning their vote, choosing Rebekah Cummings as Lt. Governor, filming an ad with Phil Lyman—**it has all led us to this moment and put us in the position to hold our opponent accountable.** I've said it from the beginning—this campaign is about more than Democrats or Republicans. It's about doing what's right and delivering results for Utahns. By moving past the bitter political partisanship present in our Legislature, we can address the issues that matter, like housing, economic security, and reproductive healthcare, helping change Utah—for the better. [**Can I count on you to make a grassroots contribution today and help our campaign take control of this election? With just one month left, your support means more than you could know. Please chip in.**](https://king4ut.us/l/SfY0oULGA8eI)

For the better, Brian King

| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/3oCVf59vFZRE)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

**Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to:**

**Brian for Utah**

Salt Lake City, UT 84158

name: Tiernan Donohue
subject: I’m actually pissed off
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
I couldn’t believe McCormick said this out loud.
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4452%2E552475%2EbiH9bO)
Peter, I’m pissed.
Last night, I watched Senator Casey debate David McCormick for the first time. And, look, I expected lies from the guy who can’t speak straight about where he lives, but what genuinely stunned me was this deeply offensive line from Dave:
**David McCormick:** “I'm not going to take any preaching from Senator Casey on my position on abortion. And, um, it's something that we need to get past.” [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241004-3?refcode=em20241004-3&refcode2=4452_552475_biH9bO&akid=4452%2E552475%2EbiH9bO)
---
Let me tell you something, Dave: Women in Pennsylvania (and across the country) aren’t going to “get past” having our rights and freedoms stripped away. We aren’t going to get past fear and anger for women living under abortion bans in 1⁄3 of this country because Roe v. Wade was overturned. Women are not going to “get past” the issue of abortion and how dare you suggest they should.
Extreme politicians like David McCormick would love nothing more than to move on from this issue because they know the vast majority of the country finds their position disqualifying.
**Let’s show David McCormick we damn sure aren’t going to “get past” abortion.****[Make a $5 donation now to punish these controlling politicians at the ballot box by advertising their deeply unpopular views on women’s rights.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241004-3?refcode=em20241004-3&refcode2=4452_552475_biH9bO&akid=4452%2E552475%2EbiH9bO)**
**[Rush a Donation ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241004-3?refcode=em20241004-3&refcode2=4452_552475_biH9bO&akid=4452%2E552475%2EbiH9bO)**
I spent a lot of time unsurprised as David McCormick lied his way through the debate last night. But that comment struck a nerve for me, and I’m sure it did for countless other women in Pennsylvania, too.
Here’s why his comment frightens me: David McCormick could win and be the next U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania. This race is locked in a dead heat, and if we don’t raise the resources we need right now to ensure every Pennsylvania voter hears about McCormick’s record on women’s rights, I fear he may pull it off and flip PA red.
That’s why I’m channeling my energy today to ask for your help. **[Please, if you can afford to right now, chip in $5 to help us blanket the airwaves with ads that hold David McCormick accountable for his opposition to women’s fundamental rights.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241004-3?refcode=em20241004-3&refcode2=4452_552475_biH9bO&akid=4452%2E552475%2EbiH9bO)**
Women’s rights and our opportunity to restore Roe is on the ballot this cycle and the clock is ticking.
But what gives me hope is knowing Bob Casey and our team are in this fight to stop David McCormick with millions of energetic, passionate supporters like YOU. Together, we will win.
Thank you for everything.
Tiernan Donohue
Campaign Manager, Bob Casey for Senate

Remember, she stands with women, unions, teachers, doctors, and for the betterment of the lives of every single Hoosier. As election night continues to move closer and early voting begins, we want to continue to encourage you to make sure you [know your voter registration status](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94286197/503102291/-1499154792?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzk4MmIzZC05MzgyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Y03xpUfPN9kaCEF2M9KhiIIGp1hseFmudWoGZzCkmuo=&emci=20a62c77-8782-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=3c982b3d-9382-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4925535) and are aware of your polling locations. Braun’s Digitally Altered Ad On September 30, Mike Braun published a digitally altered television ad disparaging Jennifer McCormick and her campaign. For Braun to sign off on the airing of an ad that is blatantly a lie is a disservice to every citizen of the great state of Indiana. Jennifer McCormick understands that Hoosiers value honesty, and she is committed to delivering that for the next four years. Braun can’t even make a tv ad without outright lying about his competition. Yet somehow, he thinks he is a trustworthy person? Frank Mrvan joined forces to host a press conference announcing new fundraising efforts to update a local all-inclusive playground and fitness park. $3 million has already been obtained for the $5 million project, with $1 million of that coming from federal funding that Rep. subject: Derek, we need you today...
body:
The final FEC deadline is this month so we urgently need your support today.
---
Derek, we have some exclusive insider news to share with our most dedicated supporters (that’s you!). Since Kamala Harris became the Democratic nominee, we’ve seen an incredible number of small-dollar donations from Democrats all over the country. Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats running at all levels are proud of the movement you’ve helped build -- and we hope you are, too. But now, they’re counting on you to step up today. Here’s why: **October 31, 2024:** Our final FEC filing deadline before Election Day, and it’s absolutely crucial that we hit our fundraising goal. The money we raise by this deadline will determine the resources we can send to must-win states to turn out voters across the country before Election Day. **Every dollar raised today makes sure we can run more ads, knock on more doors, and reach more voters who may still be undecided.** **October 4, 2024:** That’s _today_ , and this is the moment we need you, Derek. Your first contribution will directly power our path to victory on November 5. [**Whether it’s $3 or whatever you can give, your support will make a real difference in these final weeks. | | [](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1c69114da0&e=25844e23a8) Election Integrity volunteers are critical to bringing transparency and honesty to our elections. In the final push to **November 5th** , we are calling on patriots across the country to take the extra step, and volunteer to Protect the Vote! The Nebraska Election Integrity Training provides a comprehensive overview of the state election process and the important role that Poll Watchers play in upholding election integrity. All volunteers are required to complete this training. This training is closed to the press and may not be recorded by attendees. **_Virtual (Zoom) Trainings:_** [Tuesday, Oct. 8th at 12:00 PM](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=5c268c59c8&e=25844e23a8) [Thursday, Oct 10th at 6:00 PM](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=58c089dbb8&e=25844e23a8) [Saturday, Oct 12th at 12:00 PM](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=10f6597177&e=25844e23a8) Please allow 60-75 minutes for your training. We endeavor to complete the session in under an hour. If none of those times work for your schedule, please know that we will be adding trainings regularly, as well as an “On Demand” option. We will update you if we see that you have not yet completed a training when the new schedule has posted. Your participation is truly appreciated and crucial to ensuring free and fair elections in 2024. Feel free to share the registration links with friends and neighbors! Take Care & God Bless,
**Carson H. Clayton**

Deputy Election Integrity Director, NE
Republican National Committee

name: Tim Kaine
subject: The second-best time to donate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Folks, we talk a lot in politics about when and why to donate to campaigns.
The “why” is easy — we simply can’t win without resources to pay for all the voter outreach that needs to get done.
As for the “when”...
The truth is that the best time to donate to any campaign is early . The earlier we can build up funds, the earlier we can use them, and the more we can talk with voters about the stakes of the election.
We’re past early. There are just 32 days left in this election, and voting has already begun for millions of people (including here in Virginia).
So the “best” time is gone. But here’s the good news: The second-best time is right now .
Your donation today goes a whole lot farther than a donation later this month or even later this week because it allows my team to plan out the critical spending we need to do in these final weeks before Election Day.
So, how about it? Will you pitch in right now? My campaign team has a daily fundraising goal of $30,000 for every day of October, and any amount you can spare would help us reach that goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?refcode=241004em-second]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

-Tim Kaine

subject: Tell Your Story of Finding the Sacred in Every Neighbor
body:
Inspire Others with Your Story | |
---
| | | Mr. Rogers teaches us that appreciating our neighbors is more than just a kind gesture - it's participating in something sacred. As followers of Christ, we are called to mirror God's love by seeking out the good in everyone we meet. But what does it look like when we live this truth out in our families and communities?

Join believers across the nation who are sharing their stories of love and compassion on [The Good Neighbor Map](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=ed4cb995bb&e=43463f1dee). This platform highlights the acts of faith happening in every corner of the country - stories that show the real, tangible impact of Christ's love.

How will you contribute to this growing map of kindness?

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

They need our help.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94289398/503112130/1328794144?refcode=ea.c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMxM2QyMzliLTlhODItZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ks4m6iXGA7GrOt-3FmDkUn9CsxDgN1SHrvIWRQ7NPEY=&emci=12171e67-5582-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)

We can hardly find the words to describe the devastation that Hurricane Helene has left in its wake. What once were vibrant, close-knit communities are now unrecognizable. And that’s to say nothing of the dozens of other climate-related disasters happening across the globe. Entire towns have been decimated, families are still missing, and survivors are left with the unimaginable task of rebuilding their lives — many without clean water, food, or electricity. The death toll has risen to over 200 lives lost across six states, and the search for missing loved ones continues. Helene’s impact is felt far and wide, as nearly a million people remain without power, and the damage is still being assessed. In moments like this, we are reminded that these extreme weather events aren’t isolated tragedies. They are part of a broader pattern driven by the climate crisis, a crisis made worse by politicians who continue to accept millions from fossil fuel companies. Fossil fuel companies that _downplay_ and _deny_ their role in this devastation. _Enough is enough._ Right now, our hearts are with the people on the ground. The communities torn apart by Helene, the survivors left without homes, and the families still waiting for word on their loved ones. They need immediate help. That’s why we’re asking you to join us and help those impacted by Hurricane Helene and the many other climate disasters unfolding around the globe by making a donation to the American Red Cross today. **[Please consider making a donation to the American Red Cross, which is working to provide meals, relief supplies, and shelter to communities impacted by these disasters.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94289399/503112131/-1338648586?refcode=ea.c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMxM2QyMzliLTlhODItZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ks4m6iXGA7GrOt-3FmDkUn9CsxDgN1SHrvIWRQ7NPEY=&emci=12171e67-5582-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)** | [**DONATE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94289400/503112132/-1729019293?refcode=ea.c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMxM2QyMzliLTlhODItZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ks4m6iXGA7GrOt-3FmDkUn9CsxDgN1SHrvIWRQ7NPEY=&emci=12171e67-5582-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=c13d239b-9a82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)

Friday, October 04, 2024 | Peter -- Happy Friday, **Forward Friends,** here are your volunteer updates! With only 32 days until the election, there is a lot of candidate support happening. I hope this email helps you find a place to plug in these next few weeks as we work together to elect our Forward endorsed candidates. _A Special Note:_ I know we have supporters in areas that were affected by Hurricane Helene, and I just want to acknowledge that tragedy and extend my deepest condolences to those who have lost loved ones, homes and/or livelihoods. Recovery from a natural disaster takes a long time, both physically and mentally, which as a resident of Florida, I know firsthand. If there's anything I can help with on this matter, don't hesitate to mention it. _Last Week’s Highlights:_ We currently have 4 campaigns live to choose from to work on and are in the process of adding more. We continue to see new volunteers getting involved, with almost 30 people onboarded to CallHub already. I am thrilled to report that over 17,000 texts went out to voters last week! Thank you to all the volunteers who have logged on and sent texts. _Upcoming Opportunities:_ The [Monday Night Madness](meet.google.com/ssu-wudq-uxd) text banking parties are going strong, every Monday night at 8pm ET. On Monday October 14th I have a special treat for you, instead of text banking, a virtual [Meet the Forwardists](https://home.forwardparty.com/meet_the_forwardists?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends&n=2) event with Co-founder Andrew Yang and CEO Lindsey Williams Drath, to introduce a few of the candidates we are asking you to support. More info on that in next week's newsletter. Our committees will be holding text and phone banking events this month, so keep an eye out for those event listings as well. [RSVP](https://home.forwardparty.com/public_calendar?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends&n=3) for upcoming events here! _Volunteer Spotlight:_ This week, we are thrilled to highlight Forward’s Volunteer of the Month for October, Wendy Petry in Colorado. She was an integral part of the endorsement process, conducting countless interviews to make sure we were finding the right people to represent our mission, and we are very grateful for her dedication and the gift of so much of her time. We can't do this work without you, and want to make sure we show our appreciation. Thank you, Wendy! I hope you all have a wonderful weekend, and I look forward to seeing you at our upcoming events. Carrie Anne Templeton

Friend -- In many ways, the response of the US government to the 500 mile swath of destruction of Hurricane Helene shows that the war is coming home. Compare the destruction made by American bombs launched on civilians in Lebanon, Gaza, the West Bank and Ukraine, with the destruction in the mountains of North Carolina and the American Southeast. What are our priorities, and whom does our government represent? The U.S. has dealt with extreme weather throughout our history, and at one time we focused on a national mobilization to protect citizens, and to foster innovation to create protective infrastructure. So the question again is: War or Peace? What should be done? What about building infrastructure, rather than destroying human life? The Director of FEMA has stated that FEMA is "out of money" for Helene and Congress is considering returning to vote on supplementary funding, Some political forces are comparing the money spent for the financial beneficiaries of the illegal migrant caper to that available from FEMA for the hurricane: But while they debate, _Reuters_ reports on September 26, 2024 that "Israel Says It Has Secured $8.6 billion aid package", and in April, sources note that the U.S. allocated $6.18 billion to Ukraine for its 5th supplementary aid bill -- which adds up to $175 billion for the war in Ukraine since February, 2022. What are our priorities? Join the New York Symposium tonight at 8 pm EDT. **US SPENDING ON THE UKRAINE WAR \-- $175 BILLION SINCE 2022**

clean_body: Nevada's Senate race could once again be the closest in the country | | | | We have to be honest, friend. We’re a little worried that Democrats are sleeping on Nevada. Every day, the GOP’s megadonors are pouring more dark money into Nevada to defeat Jacky Rosen and flip the state red because they know this race will be close, and they know that Nevada will decide control of both the Senate and the White House. But we just checked our numbers, and grassroots donations to our campaign this month are WAY behind where they need to be – and we only have 32 days left until the election. Folks aren't fully appreciating how close this race will be, folks. A few polls may have recently come out in our favor, but get this: At this point in the election in 2022, polling had Catherine Cortez Masto up 13 pointsin Nevada, yet she ended up winning by just 0.77% of the vote –the closest margin in the entire country. Make no mistake: Jacky Rosen’s Senate race is well within the margin of error. It’s statistically TIED. And we won’t have the resources to pull ahead and win unless we reach our fundraising goals during this critical period before Election Day. Terra Lawson-Remer’s track record of failing to attend key meetings and neglecting her duties as vice chair of the Continuum of Care Advisory Board is bad enough. Now, she's embroiled in a scandal involving accusations of racism and a backroom political scheme. This latest incident highlights her pattern of being more focused on divisive politics than solving the real issues facing our county.
Lawson-Remer has proven time and again she’s unfit for office. She doesn’t show up for crucial meetings, is unprepared when she does, and has failed to attend a single session of theContinuum of Care Advisory Board where she's vice chair. This latest scandal only underscores her priorities: grandstanding over real leadership thereby leaving our county’s biggest issues unresolved.
It’s time to elect a new supervisor, a proven leader who will tackle our big problems and put forward real solutions. That’s Kevin Faulconer.

subject: Thank you, Mr. President
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
This is one of the biggest and most personally meaningful moments in our race for Florida's Senate seat. **Former President Barack Obama just endorsed me!**
To have the support from President Obama is a humbling moment. I was proud to volunteer for his campaign in 2008 and 2012, and I’m so proud to have his support in mine. He is a true public servant and a determined campaigner who has fought hard to better our nation. He believes in the grassroots movement we've built, friends — a movement that includes you. Together, with Barack Obama fighting alongside us, we will defeat Rick Scott and protect our Democratic Senate majority!
And today, my campaign is proud to launch an ad featuring President Obama speaking to the importance of our race. **[You can watch that ad here — I hope you love it as much as I do.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94291681/503119346/1261861794?refcode=jtk5508-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZDVkMWI0Ni1hMjgyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PDqtv0UJkAQFrNkrRCNqVbSAXWkWgsEqawbZGibwGKE=&emci=7c0d46b8-6d82-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2d5d1b46-a282-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=7659029)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94291682/503119347/-1736033032?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5508-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZDVkMWI0Ni1hMjgyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PDqtv0UJkAQFrNkrRCNqVbSAXWkWgsEqawbZGibwGKE=)
This endorsement will fuel a huge amount of momentum, but we cannot rest on our laurels for a second. In fact, President Obama's endorsement and belief in this race is a signal for us to work even harder. Because right now, polls show me in a statistical tie with Rick Scott, but he's already spent $37 MILLION on ads to defeat me.
President Obama knows the power of a grassroots movement — the power that people like you have when they make a donation in the name of hope and change. The latest poll from the New York Times has Donald Trump up by four points in Arizona, a complete flip from their previous result:

**PREVIOUS Times/Siena Poll, AUGUST 8-15, 2024:**
**_Trump:_** 45%
**_Harris:_** 49%

**NEW Times/Siena Poll, SEPTEMBER 17-21, 2024:**
**_Trump: 49%_** (+4%)
**_Harris:_** 45%

A viral NY Post story claims that FEMA lacks funds to support Hurricane Helene victims due to misspending on asylum seekers. The right wing tabloid is fueling dangerous misinformation and disinformation to further demonize immigrants at the southern border. This racist attack is not only false, it detracts from the real reasons FEMA lacks adequate funding, which further harms victims of Hurricane Helene and potential future storms this hurricane season. **Let 's Address This.**
Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..7ykrZubr0pxepWRC67qvRqkLlyLSf8ve9Axghnev2Dk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=149824974)
The New York Post launched their disinformation campaign with this [tweet](https://substack.com/redirect/2e6b89f6-3b20-4b9e-b198-fde01958ae62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e9c32160-b5f9-4f9a-885d-643dde7067a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
You'll notice that the NY Post makes two completely unrelated statements, and hopes that readers think correlation means causation. The article perpetuated this disinformation, writing:
> Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas set off outrage Wednesday when he told reporters that the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) "does not have the funds" to see Americans through the rest of this [Atlantic hurricane season](https://substack.com/redirect/f376bec6-be46-4861-9c2a-5b3f4ba555d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- after the agency spent more than $1.4 billion since the fall of 2022 to [address the migrant crisis](https://substack.com/redirect/f5c66350-ce8b-42f6-9d50-119ab1dffd81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). "We are meeting the immediate needs with the money that we have. We are expecting another hurricane hitting. We do not have the funds. FEMA does not have the funds to make it through the season."
Hurricane season ends November 30th. Notice, Mayorkas makes no mention of migrants as the cause of funding shortage. He wouldn't, because that is simply not the case. Instead, NY Post wants readers to believe that $1.4B over the last three years spent on migrants has caused a FEMA budget shortfall. In reality, migrants have nothing to do with FEMA's budget shortfall, but for right wing propagandists like the NY Post, facts don't matter.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..7ykrZubr0pxepWRC67qvRqkLlyLSf8ve9Axghnev2Dk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149824974)
So what is the truth of the matter?
Well, anyone condemning FEMA for running out of funds this Hurricane season should know three things:
1. This has happened now two years in a row. FEMA ran low on funds in 2023 and now again in 2024.
2. As any basic civics lesson should teach you, the House controls the purse strings. Therefore, whatever budget FEMA has, is due to the GOP led House--which ultimately controls FEMA budgeting. Therefore, FEMA being short on funds is a result of House Republicans refusing to adequately fund FEMA. This could be because MAGAs don't understand how finances work, or because they don't believe in climate change, or likely a combination of both. Either way, Republicans seem to always find money for tax cuts for billionaires, private school vouchers for the wealthy, and subsidies for Big Oil and Big Pharma. But apparently funding disaster management during a climate crisis is just too difficult.
3. The reason why Mayorkas doesn't mention the funds spent on migrants is because $640M is only 2.1% of FEMA's nearly $30B budget. Imagine believing that FEMA is out of money because 2% was spent on migrants--and not because the House GOP which controls the purse strings did not properly fund FEMA now two years in a row.

I summarized the above points in [my own viral tweets](https://substack.com/redirect/c7bb9915-ab8a-4243-a588-d2a97f3a2159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And while I was grateful the message landed with those looking for actual facts, my factual tweet still only reached a fraction of the people as the original NY Post propaganda tweet.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/46feb775-e225-4e12-8f59-4e3db11fbcc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meanwhile, thousands of MAGAs tweeted back to me in colorful language, claiming climate change is a hoax and that we shouldn't be spending any money on undocumented immigrants anyway.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/44e6ff43-0b92-4c5a-99fe-cb52e49481b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A snapshot of the responses I received for countering NY Post and MAGA propaganda.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..7ykrZubr0pxepWRC67qvRqkLlyLSf8ve9Axghnev2Dk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149824974)
First, asylum is legal immigration, and it is also our constitutional duty to uphold the law. Asylum is a human right protected by American laws as well as international law. Ignoring this obligation violates the law. I find it truly remarkable how the "party of law and order" wants to pick and choose which laws they want to follow. That's not how law and order works.
Next, not only is allocating resources for migrants a legal requirement, immigrants add far more to our economy than they could ever take. The Institute for Taxation and Economic Policy reports remarkable data you will never see published in the NY Post or any right wing tabloid acknowledge, documenting [that](https://substack.com/redirect/4bce5b7e-1465-4f32-9840-05289b55004b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
* Undocumented immigrants paid $96.7 billion in federal, state, and local taxes in 2022. Most of that amount, $59.4 billion, was paid to the federal government while the remaining $37.3 billion was paid to state and local governments.
* Undocumented immigrants paid federal, state, and local taxes of $8,889 per person in 2022. In other words, for every 1 million undocumented immigrants who reside in the country, public services receive $8.9 billion in additional tax revenue.

So to be clear, for anyone outraged that FEMA has spent $640 million on undocumented immigrants, remind them that undocumented immigrants pay nearly 100X that in federal taxes alone. In other words, for every $100 that undocumented immigrants pay in federal taxes, only $1 is spent back on undocumented immigrants. Far from a "leech" on the system, immigrants and undocumented immigrants are a massive boost to our economy. Meanwhile, you'll never hear MAGAs complain that Donald Trump has hardly paid any federal taxes, and reportedly [paid $0 in income taxes in 2020](https://substack.com/redirect/412af118-840f-45e8-8f1d-2639cd083156?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (To be sure, that is what a "leech" on the economic system looks like).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/36b90a45-b53b-4c9c-9027-26828d35c026?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Finally, just last week nearly 100 Republicans [voted against additional FEMA funding](https://substack.com/redirect/364c4814-006a-4d51-bb1a-03836428766e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and now blame immigrants for the lack of FEMA funding. Proving once more the anti-immigrant posturing is to detract from the fact that House Republicans continue to underfund FEMA and other critical social welfare programs. Even now Speaker Johnson refuses to call for additional FEMA funding, knowing full well of the dire need.
Do not let racist anti-immigrant rhetoric detract from MAGA incompetence in finance and budgeting. The solution is clear--properly fund FEMA and ensure the people devastated by Hurricane Helene can get the support they need. Unfortunately, that is the one thing the GOP seem incapable of doing. Thus, proving that old saying: _Republicans claim government doesn 't work, then they get elected and prove it._

---
| | [](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1409e15b584b4dcf9948f9b2fce526f1&_e=uWs9kXyX5KTCZ-xjpFodawqu_uKJs3vi6pOoNiaVj6sTvKhnY-L4TD4MHa0XYmjeyfdcDblCSktm8ZXlXqb18LPU_kMukcaRxwJWZojpPJFFyxtnkAOdO2VYCJh6ZtvAqZMvdL7_7dp3ZENQYZ5mjQdC3ZM2G4hY0CFipq4Tbf2ErOO5iLQNDHg_gnwVkO-LTF7bmCxNWXKB3ttuBmt3IbSKVaUzJSYSvq0OJ44uZDy8RqRtqreSOBONloscSrzu)

Hurricane Helene has hit East Tennessee and other southern states hard, leaving behind devastation across North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Florida, and Virginia. Communities have been reeling from the deadly flooding and the destruction of homes, roads, and schools. Here in TN, Newport has seen some of[ the worst flooding](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1409e15b584b4dcf9948f9b2fce526f1&_e=uWs9kXyX5KTCZ-xjpFoda6IWYgi-SHJdowTOVgf9Wu8ekiXUWSzli56-v_ysEpQfXrkpqRLqm6Ct-c7ZqsCfcMqyhDXQ6P31pZ4PvotKGN8loJC8uY0wDe8EdpUXInPUcPpIPugZCieG8A5SWrimWlR13MatO3uxM11PyfqDgjrT_c6wnGMGEpOXdrGbh2ZcNx2BUdVpviX89grkIb6SvIJzB5WGcmFX3rTxEbFslxYbBdv__b7YkNuiCbb2YAFb3H5TqZRbBywvqcK3xouReA%3D%3D), with families still struggling to clean up their neighborhoods and pick up the pieces of their lives. We’ve all seen the [photos of the damage](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1409e15b584b4dcf9948f9b2fce526f1&_e=uWs9kXyX5KTCZ-xjpFoda1AcCbj925nsTyv0w8IYqTLSYxOg-TmbhzkRaSBBnURAnAOY14DYsIdmRVUaRmqZasiFfsO3d7XlVTszNALJnkPwQpI3LlAfWe0a6Br5_30IatroEW7X6W1n87VxTSRGIIsweHIv34BXeV2G9jFU-bkqwMr7E_72OQiOcjercGplFNzjb_-bGs7brqZixcEKH0Efn_ytrVOoPs-2XXtU8aq5DUbCEcgE4-7V0VjRlNWQbfX5ZzyWCXVUe9LJ0WpqahLcIrv6Xy8Wcwna5iAcnW8UDX0S5fzli8TvVvUzMN4kBBbdzPpy8OyUU7cSw9M0Aw%3D%3D), and it’s nothing short of heartbreaking. On top of that, you’ve probably seen a lot of chatter online about the response to the storm. Let me tell you, talk is cheap—especially when it’s full of misinformation. Some folks are out there spreading rumors, but I’m here to set the record straight and share the facts about what’s really happening in our state. Here’s what’s actually going on right now on the ground:
* The Tennessee National Guard has deployed 401 soldiers and airmen, delivered over 67,500 lbs of food and water, and moved 93 truckloads of debris out of our communities.
* 1,500 lbs of household supplies have been delivered to families in need.
* The National Guard has rescued 105 people through airlifts.
* The Department of Defense has green-lit a Title 10 request, bringing in more active duty personnel and equipment to help with recovery efforts.
* TEMA has received 100 Starlink satellite systems to ensure emergency responders stay connected while they help our neighbors.

This isn’t just talk—this is real action. Our first responders, the Tennessee National Guard, and volunteers from across the state are out there every single day making a difference. These are the facts. While misinformation and rumors might be flying around, East Tennesseans know better. We don’t let noise distract us from the real task at hand—helping our neighbors and rebuilding our community. If you want to make a difference, I encourage you to donate to local organizations or volunteer your time (see details below for an event on Saturday). Now is not the time for division or distractions. Now is the time for action and unity. Let’s focus on getting our neighbors back on their feet and showing the strength of East Tennessee. Thank you for standing with me and for standing with our community.

MY LIFELONG COMMITMENT
I Need Your Help to Get Over the Finish Line
Dear Peter,
Environmental health and human health are inseparable. The toxic chemicals polluting our air, soil, and water also seep into our bodies and our children’s bodies. They damage our health the same way they destroy nature.
**That’s why good environmental policy is also good health policy.**
Just a few days ago, I stood in front of the Environmental Protection Agency in Washington, DC, reflecting on how the environment used to unite us. After all, every American loves nature and wants clean air, clean water, and a healthy future for our children.
I’ve spent my career as an attorney advocating for children’s health and the environment. When I’m in Washington in the Trump administration, I will continue both.
[We are going to **Make America Healthy Again**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-epa?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=epa_10_3_24_un1&n=5) – and that includes our soil, our water, and our bodies.
**And let me tell you one other kind of pollution** I’m going to help get rid of. It is the pollution of our government agencies by corporate money. It’s called, corruption.
When Big Pharma money, Big Ag money, and Big Tech money pollutes Washington DC, it’s not long before their chemicals pollute the entire country.
**__That’s going to end when I’m in Washington.__**
President Trump has given me his solid backing to help him clean the poisons out of our soil, our water, our bodies, and our political system.
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-epa?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=epa_10_3_24_un1&n=6)
[Please help me get over the finish line by donating to MAHAnow.org,](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-epa?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=epa_10_3_24_un1&n=7) so I can keep up the pressure and bring my lifelong commitment to health and the environment to Washington.

In 2012, I became the first gay person of color elected to Congress.

| Peter, in 2012, I became the first gay person of color elected to Congress.

So I was so proud to join my hometown, Riverside, California, for an incredible Riverside Pride celebration earlier this week! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94293122/503123859/238616526?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20241004_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDRhODIyZS1hNzgyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JkO8YXYLAFfQ42-BkX6MLwr9y6zS0KusnOA50RGgEZI=) It’s been my absolute honor to serve and represent marginalized communities in Congress. I’ve advocated for LGBTQ+ folks, stood up to transphobic hate, and sponsored the Equality Act.

It wasn’t always easy. In a 1994 bid for Congress, _I was outed by my hateful Republican opponent._ And even today, we see the Republican Party seek to further marginalize and strip folks like me of our rights to exist, live, and love.

That’s why LGBTQ+ Pride is SO important. It’s a form of resistance against those hurtful and harmful narratives. It’s a celebration of who we are. _**And it’s just a good, fun time.**_

The Pride event I attended was a reminder to me of all that is at stake this election. It’s the difference between protecting LGBTQ+ rights or seeing them dismantled entirely.

**I don’t know about you, but like Kamala Harris says: I’m not going back.**

body:
| | | | |
---
|
Hi,
I want to bring the email below to your attention. **English, Spanish, and bilingual speakers are all needed.** This is a time for all of us to come together and invest in this critical region of our state and our country. Everyone is welcome!
I hope to see you this weekend.
Gracias,Andrea
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: California Democratic Party
Date: Thu, Oct 3, 2024 at 12:33 PM
Subject: If you have been waiting for the right time to get involved, this is it.
California Democrats,
**If you have been waiting for the right time to get involved, this is it**. County Election Officials will begin to mail out ballots starting next week, marking the beginning of the 2024 voting season.
To take back the House, we know we need to talk to Latino voters in the Central Valley. For the past two years, we’ve done just that. However, we need more bilingual Spanish speakers to reach even more voters and ensure everyone has a plan to vote.
According to the UCLA Latino Data Hub, a plurality (48%) of Latino-eligible voters in California are bilingual and can be contacted in both English and Spanish. However, significant numbers of other Latino-eligible voters speak only English (34%) or only Spanish (18%).
Will you help us reach them in this critical time in the election? The future of the House depends on us.

Time is running out to advance our progressive agenda.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241004-4368-footer&t=1&akid=4368%2E420207%2EnEB85j)
Peter, it's Pramila.
**I’m reaching out because we are at a critical moment: We are officially two weeks out from the start of voting in Washington.** This upcoming election has the power to change our country forever, and I need to make sure you’re with us.
This is going to be an incredibly close election, and everything from abortion rights to our democracy itself hangs in the balance. Republican mega-donors are pulling out all the stops to keep control of Congress, and we can’t leave anything to chance.
[**That’s why I’m asking: Can you chip in $3 to fuel our GOTV efforts before voting begins on October 18th?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241004-2?refcode=em20241004-2&amount=3&refcode2=4368_420207_nEB85j&akid=4368%2E420207%2EnEB85j)

My campaign is organizing here in Seattle and in swing states and districts across the country, and your support is absolutely critical. Here’s why:
* **It powers our TV and online ads** to reach voters
* **It supports our ground team** combating misinformation
* **It energizes our grassroots volunteers** as they phone-bank

I know we can do this, Peter, but not without you. We need to reach as many voters as possible before they submit their ballots.
[**Will you pitch in today and support our final push ahead of Election Day? Your support means everything.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241004-2?refcode=em20241004-2&amount=3&refcode2=4368_420207_nEB85j&akid=4368%2E420207%2EnEB85j)

Thank you for standing with me. Together, we’ll make every single day count.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
